papers.title: OWLS: Open-world Language-conditioned Speed Fields for Zero-Shot Rover Navigation
papers.authors: Chahyon Ku, Erica Tevere, Georgios Georgakis, Rudra Mukherjee, Bernadette Bucher
papers.abstract: Semantics can provide a proxy for physical traversability. Terrain that looks like loose sand or a rock field is likely to have similar physical properties. Open-vocabulary vision-language models (VLMs) enable this physical reasoning over terrain outside any fixed label set. We present Open-world Language-conditioned Speed Fields (OWLS), which plans directly over the dense feature map of a VLM. Prompted with a description of traversable terrain, the VLM scores every pixel of a single camera image; OWLS projects these scores onto the ground, adapts them to the platform with two morphological operations, and uses the result as the speed field of a minimum-time planner, so terrain appearance and obstacle clearance shape one trajectory. OWLS needs no task-specific training, no terrain annotation, no persistent map, and no exteroceptive sensor beyond the camera. We evaluate it on a physical rover indoors and off-road, on simulated Mars and Moon rovers over 200 procedurally generated terrains, and on real planetary imagery.
papers.summary_cn: 面向开放世界零样本漫游车导航，用可通行性语义替代固定标签。OWLS让视觉语言模型按文本提示给单目图像逐像素打分，投影到地面并经两次形态学操作适配平台，作为最短时间规划速度场。无需任务训练、地形标注、持久地图或额外传感器，在室内外实车、200个程序化火星/月球仿真地形及真实行星影像上验证可行。

papers.title: UniWorld: A Unified World Model for Real-Time Visual World Simulation
papers.authors: Xin Zhang, Yabo Chen, Shuaiwei Wang, Zixuan Duan, Haibin Huang, Feng Xu, Xuelong Li
papers.abstract: Continuous visual world simulation requires coupling evolving scene geometry with temporally persistent appearance. We present UniWorld, a unified framework that integrates depth trajectories and reference appearance within a shared video generation model. The central design maintains visual and geometric histories on a common timeline. Noise-aligned overlapping continuation places generated history at the prescribed sampling noise level and commits only newly generated latents. Rolling depth latent state preserves the corresponding geometric controls, incrementally reads newly available geometry, and keeps the conditioning fixed within each sampling window. Together, these mechanisms ensure exact preservation of latent history while bounding the active depth state by the window size. We evaluate continuous generation, paired history interventions, and long-horizon behavior across diverse scene categories. The same generator supports estimated, native, and on-demand simulator depth, while cached and incremental execution paths produce bitwise-identical outputs. Appearance changes and geometric control branches operate through the same interface without modifying committed history. The measured steady-state DiT execution path achieves real-time generation throughput, demonstrating the efficiency of UniWorld for continuous visual world simulation.
papers.summary_cn: 面向连续视觉世界模拟需同时维持场景几何演化与外观时间一致的问题，UniWorld在同一视频生成模型中联合深度轨迹与参考外观，将视觉与几何历史置于共同时间线；通过噪声对齐重叠续写仅提交新潜码、滚动深度潜状态增量读取几何并在窗口内固定条件，实现历史精确保留且深度状态受窗口约束。多场景实验覆盖连续生成、成对历史干预和长时程行为，支持估计、原生与按需模拟器深度，缓存与增量路径逐位一致。

papers.title: MG-REPA: Multi-Granularity Representation Alignment for Generative Target Speaker Extraction
papers.authors: Dohwan Kim, Jung-Woo Choi
papers.abstract: Generative target speaker extraction (TSE) models achieve high-quality extraction, but suffer from considerably slow training convergence. Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training by aligning hidden states with a pre-trained Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) teacher. However, existing alignment in the speech and audio domain operates at a single granularity. For TSE, frame-level alignment leaves the global, time-invariant characteristics of the target speech implicit, whereas utterance-level alignment leaves the time-varying content implicit, even though extracting the target requires both. We propose Multi-Granularity Representation Alignment (MG-REPA), aligning the hidden states with an SSL model at the frame level and a speaker verification model at the utterance level. We further apply temporal normalization to the frame-level target, removing its utterance-level statistics so that each branch concentrates on its granularity. On Libri2Mix, MG-REPA reaches the OVRL and PESQ of a MeanFlow-TSE baseline with $3.0\times$ and $2.1\times$ fewer epochs, respectively. Trained for 750 epochs, it is competitive with the published 2,000-epoch baseline on intrusive metrics while improving non-intrusive metrics. An ablation demonstrates that MG-REPA outperforms alignment at a single granularity.
papers.summary_cn: 生成式目标说话人提取音质高但训练收敛慢，而既有表征对齐多为单一粒度：帧级忽略全局音色，句级忽略时变内容。方法在隐状态上同时对齐自监督教师的帧级表征与说话人验证模型的句级表征，并对帧级目标做时间归一化以剥离句级统计，使两分支专注各自尺度。Libri2Mix上达到基线OVRL与PESQ所需训练轮数分别减少3.0倍和2.1倍，750轮即可接近公开2000轮基线。

papers.title: PixGR: Pixel-Space Generative Decoding for Fast Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Ranran Huang, Wenjing Bian, Weixun Luo, Ye Mao, Krystian Mikolajczyk
papers.abstract: We present PixGR, an efficient framework that integrates lightweight pixel-space generative modeling into feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction to model scene uncertainty. Context observations are encoded once into a scene latent representation, which conditions generative decoding from noisy target views to produce a shared 3D Gaussian representation. We formulate this process using pixel-space flow matching, enabling end-to-end optimization of 3D reconstruction with direct pixel-space generative supervision through differentiable rendering. This avoids VAE-based latent compression and error propagation inherent in previous two-stage pipelines. To preserve feed-forward efficiency, PixGR caches the scene representation and performs iterative inference using a lightweight DiT decoder. Experiments demonstrate that PixGR outperforms regression-based approaches in challenging sparse-view settings, particularly with widely spaced observations and view extrapolation. Meanwhile, it maintains sub-second inference and remains competitive with substantially heavier pretrained generative models. Our project page is available at https://ranrhuang.github.io/pixgr/.
papers.summary_cn: 针对稀疏视角下前馈式三维重建难以建模场景不确定性的问题，提出PixGR框架：将上下文观测一次性编码为场景隐表示，再以此为条件，通过像素空间流匹配从带噪目标视图迭代生成共享的三维高斯表示，并以可微渲染实现像素级端到端监督，避免了两阶段流程中VAE压缩带来的误差累积。方法缓存场景表示并采用轻量DiT解码器，在宽基线和视角外推等困难稀疏设置下优于回归方法，同时保持亚秒级推理速度，性能可与更重的预训练生成模型竞争。

papers.title: KiRoSe: Using Kinematic Data for Efficient Segmentation of Robot Demonstrations
papers.authors: Shuangyu Xie, Kaiyuan Chen, Muhammad Zubair Irshad, Richard Cheng, Sergey Zakharov, Ken Goldberg
papers.abstract: Segmenting robot demonstration data into disjoint temporal and semantic subsegments is valuable for learning, cleaning, retrieval, and analysis. Segmentation is often performed manually in a tedious and error prone process. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have the potential for automating this process, but directly ingesting raw multi camera video streams into MLLMs can be costly and can quickly exhaust context windows. In this paper, we introduce KiRoSe (Kinematics for Robot Segmentation), a novel framework that focuses on the companion stream of robot kinematic data. Inspired by the principle of classical entropy coding, such as Huffman coding, where frequently occurring symbols are represented more compactly, we propose Sparse Motion Tokens (SMTs), a discrete kinematic vocabulary designed to compactly represent recurring, temporally localized motion patterns, which we refer to as kinematic events. SMTs are learned by encoding kinematic trajectories with temporal segment supervision and quantizing the resulting features. We use increasingly available robot demonstration subtask annotations to supervise an open language model to interpret the resulting token sequences. Evaluation against human labeled segmentation shows that KiRoSe can substantially outperform baseline segmentation methods in F1 quality and transfers zero shot to unseen robot embodiments and egocentric human motion, while preserving the language models open vocabulary knowledge. Beyond segmentation, KiRoSe tracks task progress on an unseen robot and detects when an action is being reversed.(website: https://berkeleyautomation.github.io/kirose/)
papers.summary_cn: 针对机器人示教数据需人工切分为语义子段、耗时易错，而直接输入多路视频至多模态大模型成本高、易耗尽上下文的问题，提出KiRoSe框架，利用伴随的运动学数据代替视频。受霍夫曼编码启发，设计稀疏运动token，将时序局部化的运动模式量化为离散运动学词表，再用开源语言模型结合子任务标注解释token序列，实现高效分割。实验表明该方法以极低输入成本达到与视频方案相当的分割效果。

papers.title: Squaring-the-Sphere: Distortion-Free and Seamless Panorama Generation via CubeAtlas
papers.authors: Xuhui Zuo, Chenjie Cao, Tengfei Wang, Junta Wu, Yisu Zhang, Chunchao Guo
papers.abstract: Generating 360-degree panoramas requires both local perspective fidelity and global spherical continuity. Existing representations face a trade-off: equirectangular projection (ERP) enables seamless panorama modeling but suffers from severe distortion and a domain gap to pre-trained image generators, whereas cubemaps preserve perspective geometry but often produce inconsistent faces and visible seams. We present Squaring-the-Sphere, a panoramic image generation framework built on a novel representation CubeAtlas, which unfolds all cubemap faces into a single compact canvas. By arranging orientation-aligned, rotated polar regions alongside the equatorial faces, this representation preserves the perspective geometry of cubemaps while organizing the cross-face relationships required for seamless panorama assembly. It further enables a pretrained diffusion transformer to model the complete panorama jointly in a single pass, without altering the backbone architecture or positional encoding. While CubeAtlas has a token count comparable to ERP, its structured layout makes many dense attention interactions unnecessary. We therefore introduce a layout-aware sparse attention mask that preserves the interactions required for panorama continuity while removing geometrically irrelevant token pairs. As a result, CubeAtlas achieves better quality than ERP modeling with lower attention computation. Furthermore, we introduce a training-free super-resolution technique and a fusion scheme that enhance fine details in distortion-free perspective space before achieving the final ERP panorama. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves geometric fidelity, cross-view consistency, and high-resolution visual quality over previous methods.
papers.summary_cn: 360度全景生成需兼顾局部透视保真与球面连续性，等距柱状投影畸变严重且与预训练生成器存在域差，立方体贴图则易产生面间不一致与接缝。提出Squaring-the-Sphere框架，核心是新表示CubeAtlas：将立方体各面按方向对齐展开到单张紧凑画布上，极区经旋转排列于赤道面旁，既保留透视几何又组织好跨面关系，使预训练扩散Transformer无需改动架构与位置编码即可单次联合建模全景；其token数量与ERP相当，并设计布局感知稀疏注意力掩码去除冗余交互，实现无畸变、无缝的全景生成。

papers.title: WildDepth-v2: A Synchronized RGB--LiDAR--Radar Dataset and Benchmark for Metric Depth, Motion, and Tracking of Wildlife
papers.authors: Muhammad Aamir, Sangyun Shin, Naoya Muramatsu, Matthew Wijers, Amir Patel, Andrew Loveridge, Andrew Markham
papers.abstract: Measuring animal distance and motion in metric units underpins abundance estimation, morphometrics, and movement ecology, yet monocular video lacks metric scale and wildlife datasets lack metric ground truth. We present WildDepth 2, extending the synchronized RGB-LiDAR WildDepth dataset in three directions. (i) Imaging radar: 37 RGB-LiDAR-4D-radar sequences (19,716 frames) with per-point Doppler velocity and a measured error budget, to our knowledge the first imaging-radar wildlife recordings. (ii) Benchmarking: a frozen, checksummed hidden test set for RGB-only distance estimation and RGB+sparse-LiDAR depth completion, evaluated separately on animal and background pixels. (iii) Motion and tracking: metric 3D trajectories obtained by lifting 2D tracks using LiDAR, radar, or monocular depth. Across 48,723 animal frames, object-level radar calibration improves monocular depth over scene-level LiDAR calibration without requiring LiDAR at inference (AbsRel 0.120 vs. 0.198), although animal-level LiDAR remains more accurate (0.052). Across 431 tracks, once-per-track radar scaling reduces 3D position error four-fold (2.20 to 0.58 m) and distance-sampling detection-function bias from -13% to -2%, matching once-per-track LiDAR calibration. Transferring radar Doppler onto LiDAR produces motion masks 3.7 times denser than radar alone at 72% precision, reduces moving-animal LiDAR accumulation error by 37%, and estimates radial speed (r = 0.60), albeit with approximately 50% underestimation.
papers.summary_cn: 针对野生动物监测中单目视频缺乏公制尺度、数据集缺少真值的问题，构建WildDepth-v2同步RGB-LiDAR-4D毫米波雷达数据集，含37段序列19716帧、逐点多普勒速度及首次野生动物成像雷达记录，并提供冻结隐藏测试集用于单目测距与稀疏深度补全基准。在48723帧动物数据上，目标级雷达标定将单目深度误差AbsRel由0.198降至0.120，无需推理时使用LiDAR；431条轨迹中，每轨迹一次雷达缩放使三维位置误差降低四倍，由2.20米降至0.58米。

papers.title: ResGVC: Residual Coding for High-fidelity Generative Video Compression
papers.authors: Ding Ding, Daowen Li, Ying Chen, Kai Li
papers.abstract: Generative video compression (GVC) methods usually employ decoder-side diffusion models to denoise reconstructed signals based on generative priors. Besides, most of these methods perform denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain. In this paper, we propose ResGVC, a residual coding framework for GVC that guides denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments, where each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step. Residual segments can further be compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model. Unlike prior methods, ResGVC introduces explicit source constraints throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. The diffusion-based entropy model also enables more effective distribution modeling capability based on the powerful generative priors. Moreover, denoising directly in pixel space avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results show that, compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while also delivering superior visual quality.
papers.summary_cn: 针对生成式视频压缩过度依赖解码端扩散先验、潜空间去噪导致信息不可逆损失的问题，提出残差编码框架ResGVC：先用学习式视频编解码器重建原图，再将重建失真分解为与各去噪步对应的残差段，经以扩散Transformer为熵模型的残差编解码器压缩传输，从而在像素域去噪全程引入显式信源约束。该方法强化了分布建模能力，避免潜空间瓶颈损失，实现高保真视频压缩。

papers.title: UniFlowWAM: A Unified World-Action Model with Visual Semantics and 4D Geometry
papers.authors: Jialin Tian, Zhuofan Li, Xinkai Wang, Bokai Lin, Chenyi Wang, Xinyu Zhan, Cewu Lu, Lixin Yang
papers.abstract: Robot demonstrations record what the robot saw and what it did. They do not specify how the 3D world changed in between. Scene-level 3D flow describes it by tracking 3D scene points, providing the world representation with 4D geometry. Prior work has used flow to improve robot policies. Flow served as an intermediate prediction that a separate model converts into actions, as a prior injected at inference time, or as an extra output learned together with the action. In all of these designs, flow stays outside the policy, as a separate module or as an extra prediction head. We introduce UniFlowWAM, a Unified World-Action Model that makes 3D scene flow a third modality on par with vision and action. Its world representation therefore covers both visual semantics, through future visual features, and 4D geometry, through 3D flow, and flow receives its own supervision. UniFlowWAM is a diffusion transformer with one expert per modality, and the three experts exchange information through joint attention. We train UniFlowWAM under a ten-objective role grid, where each objective assigns every modality exactly one of three roles, namely target, condition, or absent. The same model thus serves as a policy, as forward and inverse dynamics, and as a predictor of future visual features or 3D flow. We evaluate UniFlowWAM on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus in simulation, and on four real-world bimanual manipulation tasks. On RoboCasa-GR1, UniFlowWAM raises the success rate of its base model without flow from 52.1% to 56.4%. It preserves in-distribution success on LIBERO at 98.1% and reaches 87.7% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus. On the real robot, it achieves 87.0% average success, compared with 68.5% for the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_cn: 针对示范只记录所见与动作、缺失三维世界变化的问题，该工作把三维场景流列为与视觉、动作并列的第三模态：未来视觉特征承载语义，三维流提供四维几何并获单独监督。扩散变换器设三个模态专家，经联合注意力互通，在十目标角色网格中训练，每目标将模态指定为目标、条件或缺失。

papers.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
papers.authors: Songlin Yang, Zhe Wang, Xiaotong Zhao, Xi Wang, Ran Zhang, Shuai Li, Taiyi Wu, Songlian Li, Eric Liu, Alan Zhao, Anyi Rao
papers.abstract: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction. We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL), which establishes effective MLLM latent use as a shared prerequisite and then targets the two capabilities with complementary learning signals. First, latent-only generator grounding trains the DiT with a frozen MLLM and connector, strengthening the DiT's use of MLLM latents for generation. Second, for factor-aware control, paired videos specify a target-factor change and non-target preservation, and factor-span replacement trains the DiT to realize this relationship in its output. Third, for temporal inference, text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it. This final stage trains limited-input representations for generation while retaining complete-observation reconstruction as a complementary training mode. Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks (i.e., sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL's contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination.
papers.summary_cn: 电影级视频生成需要从稀疏输入进行时间推理，并对角色、场景、动作、镜头实现因子化控制，但多模态大模型的表征难以直接被视频扩散Transformer有效利用。为此提出因子感知预测学习框架：先通过仅潜变量的生成器对齐训练冻结MLLM与连接器，强化DiT对MLLM潜变量的使用；再利用配对视频与因子跨度替换实现目标因子改变、非目标因子保持的精准控制；最后借助文本与完整视频共享目标的训练增强时间推理能力。实验表明该方法在因子可控性与时序连贯性上均取得提升。

papers.title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
papers.authors: Yunhao Luo, Wentao He, Yinpei Dai, Hyelin Nam, Hongze Fu, Joyce Chai, Nima Fazeli, Jeong Joon Park
papers.abstract: Existing world models typically perceive a scene through current visual frame or a narrow history window. However, these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction. Without calibrating these physics factors for world models, predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes. To this end, we propose PhysiCalWorld, which calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling. Our method encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token, which grounds subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior. PhysiCalWorld is trained end-to-end with the latent prediction loss alone, without physics labels. At inference time, the descriptor token is extracted once and can be reused across rollouts with negligible compute overhead. We evaluate PhysiCalWorld across four environments covering diverse physics variations and show that it substantially improves rollout prediction accuracy and visual planning success rate. The learned descriptors also form a physically structured latent space and generalize beyond the physics ranges seen during training.
papers.summary_cn: 现有世界模型仅凭当前帧或短期历史观测场景，无法获知质量分布、关节阻尼、表面摩擦等决定动态变化的物理属性，导致预测回归经验先验并在新场景中严重漂移。PhysiCalWorld 通过上下文提示校准动作条件世界模型，将测试场景中采集的探索性交互片段编码为紧凑的物理描述符 token，使后续预测贴合真实物理行为，无需微调、解析物理建模或物理标签，仅靠潜在预测损失端到端训练，推理时描述符提取一次即可复用。在四个涵盖多样物理变化的环境中，该方法显著提升了滚动预测性能。

papers.title: Orbitol: Crystal Generation on Wyckoff Orbits
papers.authors: Ivan Žugec, Joshua Rosenthal, Ivor Lončarić, Jan-Willem van de Meent, Tin Hadži Veljković
papers.abstract: Generative models propose crystalline materials by learning composition and geometry, but unconditional sampling gives no direct control over the space group, which constrains whether responses such as piezoelectricity are symmetry-allowed. We present Orbitol, a crystal generator built on the Crystalite diffusion Transformer that replaces atom tokens with Wyckoff-orbit tokens. Given a space group and a collection of occupied Wyckoff positions, Orbitol generates the atom type and free coordinates of each orbit together with a compatible lattice, so every valid structure is invariant under the operations of the requested group. It generates structures two to three orders of magnitude faster than the symmetry-aware baselines at the evaluated settings. On MP-20, 13.8% of Orbitol's attempts yielded stable or metastable, unique and novel structures that retained the requested space group after relaxation, compared with 10.8% for SGFM, the next best model. We also introduce SPARC, a score that combines retention of the raw detected space group with agreement between the retained-group and training distributions. Finally, we used Orbitol to generate candidates in piezoelectric crystal classes. Of the structures selected by internal screening, 89% passed our density functional theory checks, and 79% also matched no Materials Project or Alexandria entry with the same space group. Their median figure of merit was nine times that of the piezoelectric materials computed in the Materials Project, and 24% of the new candidates ranked in that set's top 10%.
papers.summary_cn: 面向可控晶体生成中难以指定空间群、进而限制压电等对称响应的问题，Orbitol在Crystalite扩散Transformer上用Wyckoff轨道标记替代原子标记，按给定空间群和占据位置联合生成轨道原子种类、自由坐标与相容晶格，使有效结构天然满足目标对称；采样比对称基线快2–3个数量级，MP-20上13.8%尝试弛豫后保持目标群且稳定/亚稳、独特新颖，优于次优SGFM的10.8%，并提出SPARC指标用于压电候选筛选。

papers.title: How Do DiTs Denoise? An Aggregator-Predictor View of Attention and MLPs
papers.authors: Gyeonghun Kang, William Xingxu Chen, Xiang Cheng
papers.abstract: How do diffusion transformers (DiTs) represent image content and learn rules for reusing it to generalize? We develop an aggregator--predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers, in which context aggregation and patch prediction provide functional roles for interpreting attention and MLPs. We first establish that, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) priors, the global Bayes denoiser can be approximated using only a subset of context patches, with error decaying exponentially in context radius. We further show that patchwise linear denoisers, often invoked to explain diffusion generalization, recover the empirical local denoiser with sufficiently informative aggregation. Within this view, AdaLN-modulated attention naturally parameterizes an input- and noise-dependent aggregator, while the MLP admits a learned key--value representation for tokenwise patch prediction. Our experiments support this view. DiTs trained on real images exhibit noise-dependent denoising contexts resembling those in the analytic GMRF setting, while attention mass exhibits a qualitatively corresponding broadening pattern. In a controlled CelebA64 study, shared-memory patch predictors used in place of DiT MLPs achieve competitive denoising and generative performance. Finally, cross-dataset component transplantation reveals compatibility patterns consistent with the proposed roles of QK in spatial weighting, VO in feature transport, and MLPs in patch prediction. Together, these results provide a component-level account of DiT denoising and motivate architecture-specific fine-tuning and controlled intervention.
papers.summary_cn: 扩散Transformer如何表征并复用图像内容以泛化去噪尚不清晰。提出聚合器—预测器视角：在高斯马尔可夫随机场先验下，全局贝叶斯去噪器可用局部上下文块近似，误差随上下文半径指数衰减；AdaLN调制的注意力充当随输入和噪声变化的聚合器，MLP则以键值形式执行逐块预测。实验显示真实图像训练的DiT呈现噪声依赖的去噪上下文，注意力分布相应展宽，CelebA64受控实验进一步验证了共享记忆块预测器的作用。

papers.title: Open-Vocabulary Models and Label Propagation for Uncertainty-aware Pseudo-Labeling of Object Detection Datasets
papers.authors: Jonathan Klees, Timo Heller, Matthias Rottmann
papers.abstract: Object detection models rely on large-scale annotated datasets that require substantial manual annotation effort. The labeling costs further increase when annotation uncertainty is captured through soft labels, as multiple annotations must be collected for each object. We address this challenge by introducing a semi-supervised framework for the uncertainty-aware annotation of object detection datasets. Our approach leverages open-vocabulary object detectors to generate region proposals and semantically meaningful object representations. Based on these representations, we construct an object-level similarity graph and propagate probabilistic label information. Our framework assigns soft labels to previously unlabeled objects, quantifying both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. We evaluate our method on four object detection benchmarks with soft-label annotations and demonstrate that high-quality annotations can be obtained with only a small fraction of manually labeled objects. Furthermore, we show that detectors trained on semi-automatically annotated data achieve performance comparable to models trained on fully manually annotated data. We achieve state-of-the-art downstream detection performance for the task of semi-supervised object detection on the COCO dataset, with 40.5% AP virtually matching the performance of the model trained on fully manually constructed data (40.9%) at only 1% of labeling costs. These results highlight the potential of open-vocabulary models and graph-based label propagation for efficient, accurate and uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling.
papers.summary_cn: 针对目标检测数据集软标签标注成本高、需多人重复标注以刻画不确定性的问题，提出一种半监督的不确定性感知标注框架：利用开放词汇目标检测器生成区域提议与语义化物体表示，构建物体级相似度图并传播概率标签，为未标注物体分配软标签，同时量化偶然不确定性与认知不确定性。在四个带软标签标注的检测基准上验证表明，仅需少量人工标注即可获得高质量标注，且用半自动标注数据训练的检测器性能可与全人工标注数据训练的模型相当。

papers.title: SAKURA: Serving Attention Key-Value State Under Rate Adaptation for Private Image Editing on Phones
papers.authors: Shuncheng Jie, Desen Sun, Ri Hong, Yuyang Tian, Hong Zhang, Sihang Liu
papers.abstract: Diffusion transformers are widely used in image-editing services. To preserve both efficiency and privacy, existing systems commonly rely on cloud-device collaboration. Keeping request-specific inference on the device avoids sending personal images and prompts to the cloud. These workloads often use common templates, such as in face swapping and virtual try-on, enabling KV state to be precomputed and reused across requests. However, this reusable state is large and scales with the number of templates, making it impractical to store all of them on mobile devices. Storing them in the cloud addresses this capacity issue, but cache transfer is placed onto the inference path and can even be slower than on-device computation, especially under fluctuating mobile networks.   We introduce SAKURA, a cloud-edge architecture that delivers reusable attention state to mobile devices under a bandwidth budget. It first uses a fine-grained token-importance-aware compression method to preserve image quality under limited transfer budgets. At runtime, SAKURA adaptively selects the cache representation for each upcoming shard based on network bandwidth. To enable efficient execution, we develop a pipelined runtime that overlaps cache transfer and reconstruction with on-device execution. We evaluate SAKURA using three editing tasks and two diffusion models, using a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 phone. SAKURA reduces latency by 1.82x and 3.27x over CacheGen adapted to DiT and on-device generation, respectively. It also reduces cache storage by 3.06x over uncompressed cache, while preserving image quality.
papers.summary_cn: 面向手机端私密图像编辑中模板KV缓存过大、云端传输易受移动网络波动影响的问题，将可复用注意力状态存于云端，按词元重要性细粒度压缩，并在运行时依据带宽为下一分片自适应选择缓存表示，同时通过流水线重叠传输与计算，在有限传输预算下保持编辑质量并降低端到端时延。

papers.title: Spatially Gated Demographic Steering for Debiasing Multi-Person Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Venkatesh Thirugnana Sambandham, Torsten Schon
papers.abstract: Text-to-Image models reproduce societal stereotypes, and existing mitigation applies one demographic correction to the whole scene. In multi-person scene generation this creates a trade-off: global steering improves aggregate balance only by homogenizing the people within an image. Steering-based methods like Embedding Arithmetic drive the intra-image diversity below the unsteered baseline. Text- and latent-projection approaches shift the aggregate skew with only marginal gains in intra-image diversity. We present Spatially Gated Steering (SGS), which steers the demographics of each person independently by extracting per-person masks from the Diffusion Transformer's (DiT) internal attention maps at a critical denoising timestep and applying a distinct demographic vector within each mask for the remaining steps. SGS needs no fine-tuning, inversion or layout specifications, and uses a lightweight segmentor over frozen DiT attention features to localize subjects at early timesteps. On skewed occupational prompts, SGS reaches high intra-image racial and gender diversity while keeping aggregate balance competitive and image quality near baseline, a result we validate on two architecturally distinct diffusion transformers, FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Large. Codebase and model weights are available at https://github.com/cvims/spatially-gated-steering
papers.summary_cn: 针对多人生成中全局去偏把个体同质化的问题，提出空间门控转向：在关键去噪步从DiT注意力图提取每人掩码，后续步骤在各掩码内施加不同人口学向量；无需微调、反演或版式。结果显示倾斜职业提示下图内种族与性别多样性高，总体平衡有竞争力，画质接近基线，并在两种架构验证。

papers.title: Reading the Room: Scale-ambiguous Semantic Registration of Sparse VSLAM Maps to Floor Plans in Partially Built Environments
papers.authors: Bjorn Stragier, Emilia Szymańska, J. Micah Prendergast, Lukas Rosenberger Schmid
papers.abstract: Many robotic construction applications, such as progress tracking, require registering a sensor trajectory to a prior 2D floor plan. Visual capture is attractive for its low cost and availability, but aligning a visual simultaneous localization and mapping (VSLAM) map to a floor plan is difficult; VSLAM recovers geometry only up to an unknown similarity transform, the sparse point cloud is cross-modal to the symbolic floor plan, sites are only partially built during capture, and construction sites are visually repetitive, degrading map quality while removing distinctive features. Existing methods address at most two of these challenges. We thus introduce Reading the Room(RR), a global-local approach to register scale-ambiguous, sparse, semantic VSLAM maps to partially built floor plans. Our key idea is to define a single robust, differentiable, class-balanced semantic-geometric energy function that governs all stages of the pipeline. We develop two global initialization schemes, leveraging a single inaccurate user-provided correspondence if provided, or estimating the initialization globally using a cross-modal matching network. Both schemes are designed to find initial candidates with respect to the energy function, which is then directly optimized for local refinement. We evaluate RR on 33 sequences across three active construction sites against classical and learning-based baselines, achieving a 4.5x improvement in mean absolute trajectory error over the strongest baseline in the general unconstrained setting, which increases to 7.6x when an anchor is provided.
papers.summary_cn: 解决建筑进度跟踪中稀疏语义视觉SLAM地图与部分建成二维平面图的跨模态配准难题，需同时应对相似变换尺度模糊、点云稀疏、场景未完工及视觉重复四大挑战，而现有方法最多处理其中两项。提出全局—局部配准方法Reading the Room，核心是定义单一鲁棒、可微、类别平衡的语义几何能量函数统一驱动各阶段，并设计两种全局初始化方案：利用单个不精确的人工对应点，或借助跨模态匹配网络全局估计，从而生成初始候选实现可靠配准。

papers.title: AutoPhyX: Automatic Text-Condition Physics Property Generation
papers.authors: Bei Huang, Yixin Chen, Hongbin Zha, Yuru Pei, Siyuan Huang
papers.abstract: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties. Previous methods struggle with critical bottlenecks: they either rely on computationally intensive per-scene optimization or predict parameters from purely visual inputs. The latter suffers from inherent ambiguity, e.g., the inability to distinguish the stiffness of rubber from its appearance alone. To bridge this gap, we propose AutoPhyX, a text-conditioned framework for predicting spatially-varying physical properties. Since training robust feed-forward models requires fine-grained supervision, we first introduce a novel part-controllable data generation pipeline that decomposes complex 3D assets into semantically distinct components and pairs them with physically plausible, diverse parameters and corresponding text descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, AutoPhyX employs a cross-modal modulation mechanism where text features dynamically modulate visual features for precise physical grounding. By formulating property prediction within a voxel field, AutoPhyX ensures compatibility with diverse 3D representations, including meshes, point clouds, Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF. Experiments demonstrate that our method enables physically plausible, text-driven parameter assignment in a single forward pass. It achieves high accuracy and robust generalization to in-the-wild objects, paving the way for future physics-intensive embodied and robotic applications.
papers.summary_cn: 面向高保真4D物理仿真中材质参数赋值难、纯视觉判断刚度有歧义且逐场景优化昂贵的问题，AutoPhyX以文本为条件预测空间变化的物理属性：先用部件可控生成把3D资产拆成语义部件并配对合理参数与描述，再以跨模态调制让文本动态校准视觉特征，体素场形式兼容网格、点云和高斯；摘要主要宣称可前馈落地并缓解歧义，未给具体数值。

papers.title: Sparsity Should Be ALLOTted by Output: Training-Free Allocation of Block-Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Tianze Xia, Xiaoling Zhou, Ruya Lan, Yiqiao Liao, Chengru Song, Shiming Xiang
papers.abstract: Full 3D attention is costly in video Diffusion Transformers. Block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only selected attention blocks. However, existing methods either overlook the potential to optimize sparsity allocation or rely on heuristic rules or local metrics to guide it. In this work, we observe that sparsifying attention in different layers and at different denoising steps affects final-video fidelity to substantially different degrees. Yet the identities of the most sensitive layer-step pairs remain nearly unchanged across inputs. Building on these findings, we propose Allocating Layer-step Latency by Output Tests (ALLOT), a training-free sparsity allocation method. Treating each layer-step pair as a cell, ALLOT estimates each cell's contribution to final-video error through (i) cell probing and (ii) trajectory calibration, then jointly optimizes cell densities under a measured-latency budget. It preserves existing selection strategies and kernels, replacing only the allocation component. At equal or shorter wall-clock time, ALLOT outperforms every compared allocation strategy with XAttention, with an 11.8 dB PSNR gain on HunyuanVideo. Extensive experiments across four additional published pipelines on Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo show that ALLOT outperforms or ties the default in all nine settings.
papers.summary_cn: 视频扩散Transformer中全3D注意力计算成本高，现有块稀疏方法缺乏对稀疏分配的优化。研究发现不同层和去噪步的稀疏化对视频保真度影响差异大，但敏感的层-步组合在不同输入间保持稳定。据此提出免训练的ALLOT方法，将每个层-步对视为单元，通过单元探测与轨迹校准估计其对最终误差的贡献，在实测延迟预算下联合优化各单元密度，兼容现有选择策略与核。在HunyuanVideo上搭配XAttention，等耗时或更短时PSNR提升11.8 dB。

papers.title: LLMSeg: Training-Free Text-Prompted Image Segmentation with B-Splines
papers.authors: Abdullah Hamdi
papers.abstract: Promptable segmentation models such as SAM 3 achieve remarkable open-vocabulary performance but require dedicated architectures, large-scale annotation engines, and task-specific training. We ask a different question: can a general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) segment images directly, without an added segmentation head, mask decoder, or training? We present LLMSeg, a training-free pipeline that turns a vision-capable LLM into a text-prompted image segmenter. LLMSeg decomposes segmentation into three LLM-driven stages. First, detect localizes all instances matching a free-form text query and describes their coarse morphology. Next, segment traces each instance using closed periodic B-splines confined to its detected box. These splines define an outer boundary and optional hole loops. Finally, refine iteratively proposes focus boxes around residual errors and retraces confined splines. The process ends when the mask stabilizes or the pass budget is exhausted. The output is a binary mask with inspectable intermediate geometry. We evaluate LLMSeg across ten referring and reasoning segmentation splits (ReasonSeg and RefCOCO/+/g). We also evaluate open-vocabulary instance segmentation (LVIS, COCO, and SA-Co), semantic segmentation, and zero-shot detection (ODinW13 and RF-100VL). With an off-the-shelf Gemini-3.7-Flash backend, LLMSeg is competitive with and often surpasses the specialist SAM 3 model on identical items. It reaches 71.5 cIoU on ReasonSeg val without additional segmentation-specific training. Backend model updates can improve accuracy without retraining the pipeline. The code is available at https://abdullahamdi.com/llmseg .
papers.summary_cn: 针对可提示分割依赖专用结构、海量标注与任务训练的问题，提出免训练流程，让具备视觉能力的多模态大模型直接按文本提示分割：三阶段中先定位全部匹配实例并描述粗形态，再在检测框内用闭合周期样条勾画外边界与孔洞，最后围绕残差误差迭代聚焦重描，直至掩码稳定或预算耗尽。十个指代/推理分割集上验证可用，中间几何可检查。

papers.title: NeuralSRender: G-Buffer Guided Video Diffusion for Sim-to-Real Rendering
papers.authors: Yipeng Lu, Youqi Liao, Zhenyu Wang, Yuning Peng, Zhen Dong
papers.abstract: The scarcity of high-quality annotated visual data remains a critical bottleneck for autonomous-driving perception. Simulators provide training data at scale, but the limited realism of synthetic videos compromises perception performance in real-world applications. To address this limitation, we propose NeuralSRender, a sim-to-real video translation framework that enhances the photorealism of synthetic videos while maintaining geometric consistency with the source scenes. Built on a pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT), NeuralSRender uses a lightweight projector to inject geometric and material priors from G-buffers, and LoRA enables parameter-efficient adaptation. The model is trained in two stages: it first learns G-buffer conditioning from synthetic videos with accurate G-buffers, then adapts to real-world appearance using real videos with estimated G-buffers. During the second stage, an additional LoRA module is trained while the projector and first-stage LoRA remain frozen to reduce interference from estimation noise. NeuralSRender introduces only 1.45\% parameter overhead and can be trained on consumer-grade GPUs with 24 GB of memory. To support training and evaluation, we introduce GenReal, a large-scale driving video dataset comprising synthetic and real-world videos with corresponding G-buffers. Experiments demonstrate improved photorealism with competitive geometric consistency. Training perception models on our translated videos instead of raw simulator renders improves detection $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$ on nuImages from 35.1 to 40.6 and segmentation mIoU on Cityscapes from 32.4 to 40.8. Our code, data, and model weights are available at: https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/NeuralSRender.
papers.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知中高质量标注数据稀缺、仿真视频真实感不足的问题，提出基于预训练视频扩散Transformer的仿真到真实视频转换框架NeuralSRender。通过轻量投影器注入G-buffer的几何与材质先验，结合LoRA实现参数高效适配，并采用两阶段训练策略：先利用精确G-buffer的合成视频学习条件控制，再借助估计G-buffer的真实视频适配真实外观，第二阶段冻结已有模块以抑制估计噪声干扰。该方法仅引入1.45%的额外参数，可在24GB显存的消费级GPU上训练，在提升视频真实感的同时保持与源场景的几何一致性。

papers.title: A Unified Evaluation Framework of Physical Adversarial Robustness in the Edge VLM Era
papers.authors: Eric Liang, Alan Luo, Kaiwen Yuan
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable end-to-end visual grounding via language prompts and generative decoding, demonstrating largely improved zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection capabilities. As a result, VLMs are rapidly being deployed at the edge in safety-critical real-world systems. However, the physical adversarial robustness of edge VLMs has not been systematically studied, and the fundamental differences in output with modern object detectors create methodological challenges for fair evaluation. To compare the two families directly, we evaluate every selected representative model on one outcome: whether an adversarial patch worn on a person evades detection of the model. We report this by introducing a unified metric, conditional attack success rate (cASR), counted only on images the model still localizes under a matched gray occluder, and partition every failure into omission (no box), substitution (a box on the patch), and displacement (a box on neither). We benchmark the physical adversarial vulnerability of compact grounding VLMs against a range of object detectors, and find that the VLMs can be as vulnerable as the detectors. We disclose that failure mode is largely associated with the output format of a model rather than its architecture family. Of the three, only omission is visible to a downstream system; displacement and substitution return confident, well-formed boxes, making them potentially more dangerous failures. Further, we find that, under distribution shift, VLMs that primarily failed by omission instead shift to failing more by displacement/substitution. Thus, a grounding VLM can inherit the detector's vulnerability while showing the possibility to adopt more dangerous failure modes. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness.
papers.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型在边缘安全场景中物理对抗鲁棒性缺乏系统评估、且与传统目标检测器输出形式不同难以公平比较的问题，提出统一评估框架，以佩戴对抗补丁的行人能否逃避检测为标准，设计条件攻击成功率指标，仅在灰色遮挡下仍能定位的图像上统计，并将失败分为遗漏、替换和位移三类。对多种紧凑型定位视觉语言模型与目标检测器的基准测试表明，前者与后者同样易受物理对抗攻击。

papers.title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
papers.authors: Ivan Listopadov, Maksim Nakhodnov, Aibek Alanov
papers.abstract: Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels. In practice, this requires choosing a timestep, a block, and a channel subset. Existing methods either fix these choices by hand or optimize only a few extraction hyperparameters, most often the timestep, then reuse the same rule across inputs and budgets. We introduce Policy-Mask, a budget-conditioned policy trained on the downstream objective that jointly selects all three under a prescribed channel budget. Without normalization, the channel-score contribution grows with the number of selected channels and dominates the timestep and block updates. We normalize it by subset cardinality, keeping the three policy heads on comparable scales and stabilizing joint training. At matched budgets, Policy-Mask improves over fixed extraction and feature-filter baselines across segmentation, classification, and semantic correspondence, reaching 38.9 mIoU on ADE20K, 75.4% top-1 on CIFAR-100 at 128 dimensions, and 76.3 PCK@0.1 on SPair-71k. Component-wise ablations show that block selection materially affects downstream accuracy, and the highest recorded channel-budget score occurs at 256 retained channels, identifying a practical operating point for compact diffusion representations. We further adapt Policy-Mask to diffusion transformers, including PixArt-$Σ$ and SD3.5 MMDiT, by replacing U-Net channels with image-token hidden dimensions.
papers.summary_cn: 针对从冻结扩散模型中提取判别性特征时，需在去噪时间步、网络深度和通道三个维度上选择而现有方法多为手工固定或只优化时间步的问题，提出Policy-Mask：一种预算条件的策略，在下游任务目标下联合选择三个维度并满足预设通道预算，其中对通道分数按子集基数归一化以稳定联合训练。在相同预算下，该方法在分割、分类和语义对应任务上均优于固定提取基线，ADE20K达38.9 mIoU，CIFAR-100在128维下达75.4% top-1，SPair-71k达76.3 PCK@0.1。

papers.title: Register Anything Model for Generalizable and Robust Point Cloud Registration
papers.authors: Zheng Qin, Junhua Xi, Yan Huang, Jiahong Lai, Anwen Huang, Qiong Li, Guangda Zhang, Kai Xu
papers.abstract: We present Register Anything Model (RAM), a unified model for generalizable 3D point cloud registration that robustly estimates 6-DoF transformations across diverse domains spanning sensors and environments. Existing registration methods are typically tailored to a single domain, with carefully tuned architectures and hyperparameters, and thus degrade markedly when applied to novel domains. We bridge this gap by training a single model on diverse data from indoor, outdoor, and object domains. A central challenge is the severe geometric discrepancy across domains, i.e., differences in scene scale, sensor noise, point density, and structural patterns, which hinders processing with a unified point-based model. To address this, we introduce a geometry-aware normalization strategy that jointly voxelizes and normalizes point clouds into a standardized geometric space, adaptively based on their geometric properties to preserve salient local structures while standardizing resolution. Built on this normalization, RAM follows a hierarchical coarse-to-fine paradigm, and employs an efficient geometric transformer that models local geometric consistency instead of globally over all points. This design mitigates discretization noise introduced by voxelization, and improves computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in terms of inlier ratio and registration recall. Notably, our method outperforms the counterparts trained on each separate domain, showing superior generalization capability.
papers.summary_cn: 针对点云配准方法通常只适配单一域、跨传感器与场景泛化差的问题，提出统一模型 RAM，用室内、室外和物体等多域数据训练，直接估计六自由度变换。核心是先按场景尺度、噪声、密度和结构进行几何感知归一化，把点云统一到标准几何空间并保留局部显著结构，再采用层次化由粗到精配准与高效几何 Transformer，建模局部几何一致性而非全局关系。结果显示单一模型在跨域数据上保持稳健泛化，缓解新域性能明显下降。

papers.title: GALA: Geometry-Aware Language Model for Controllable Object Arrangement
papers.authors: Chucheng Xiang, Runze Wang, Zhi Deng, Ruchao Bao, Yuanwei Zhang, Yuxuan Xie, Hanliu Wang, Liangzhen Fei, Wenzheng Wu, Cheng Wan, Peifeng Li, Zhongyuan Liu, Ligang Liu
papers.abstract: Reasoning about fine-grained placement constraints, such as support and containment, is essential for realistic 3D scene creation. It remains a significant challenge for existing methods that rely on simplified object representations like oriented bounding box (OBB), which are blind to the detailed geometry. To address this limitation, we introduce GALA, a geometry-aware language model with explicit point cloud perception for controllable object placement. Our model performs autoregressively by predicting the 6D pose of one target object at a time conditioned on the scene context and placement instruction. We utilize a two-stage training strategy: the first stage aligns geometric and textual modalities through pretraining tasks, and the second stage fine-tunes the model for placement. To facilitate this task, we also curate a multi-source scene dataset covering diverse room types and fine-grained furniture arrangements, which will be open-sourced for community benefit. Experiments on our benchmark show our model significantly outperforms baselines without explicit geometric reasoning. We further develop a multi-stage plan-place-verify agent pipeline that uses the model for text-driven scene generation. Project Page: https://xccelephant.github.io/paper/gala/
papers.summary_cn: 针对3D场景生成中现有方法依赖有向包围盒等简化表示、难以推理支撑与包含等细粒度摆放约束的问题，提出几何感知语言模型GALA，显式引入点云感知，以自回归方式逐次预测目标物体的6D位姿，并以场景上下文和摆放指令为条件。采用两阶段训练：先通过对齐几何与文本模态的预训练，再针对摆放任务微调，同时构建涵盖多类房间和细粒度家具布局的多源场景数据集并将开源。实验表明该模型显著优于缺乏显式几何推理的基线，并基于此构建了多阶段规划-摆放-验证智能体流程。

papers.title: MoDDiT: Simple Token Routing in Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Jarek Liesen, Matthew T. Jackson, Benjamin Ellis, Shimon Whiteson, Jakob N. Foerster
papers.abstract: Real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis are almost a reality. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve excellent sample quality, shifting the bottleneck to the throughput of the models themselves. Natural images are inherently sparse, as large portions of an image are often background, contribute little to the scene content, and are easy to denoise. DiTs fail to exploit this sparsity, as they process image tokens statically and uniformly. We propose MoDDiT, a simple architecture modification that learns to route tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations. By routing tokens through both blocks independently, MoDDiT allows for dynamic compute allocation in MLPs that varies across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps. Using MoDDiT to train image generation models from scratch significantly reduces computational costs of training and inference, processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens. By increasing sparsity and model depth, MoDDiT reduces costs and improves generation performance over unrouted baselines. The learned allocation is interpretable, revealing how computation varies with visual content and noise level. We also use MoDDiT to train video generation models, where allocation correlates with motion, and to distill a dense bidirectional video model into a sparse autoregressive student.
papers.summary_cn: 针对扩散Transformer对所有图像token均匀静态处理、未利用自然图像稀疏性而导致算力浪费的问题，提出MoDDiT架构，让模型学习将token独立路由经过MLP和自注意力模块，使计算量随token、图像内容及去噪时间步动态分配。从头训练图像生成模型时，最少仅处理12.5%的token即可显著降低训练和推理成本；提高稀疏度和模型深度后，性能还优于无路由基线，且学到的计算分配具有可解释性。

papers.title: Recast the Past: Stable Long Video Generation with Full Context Memory
papers.authors: Yukuo Ma, Cong Liu, Junke Wang, Junqi Liu, Haibin Huang, Zuxuan Wu, Xuelong Li
papers.abstract: Long-horizon video generation requires retaining an ever-expanding history, but conditioning on its growing token sequence is costly. Existing methods restrict or compress historical context, potentially losing information needed for future generation. This work proposes ReCam, which groups local spatiotemporal blocks of historical latents into vectors and projects them directly into the high-dimensional hidden space of a Diffusion Transformer. The model learns to use the resulting memory tokens through native self-attention, reducing token count while retaining block-level access to the full history. To mitigate temporal drift during autoregressive rollout, we further introduce dual-pointer denoising with separate noise schedules for recent context and target frames. Among the evaluated methods, ReCam achieves the highest VBench-Long overall score of 80.1 and competitive static-scene revisitation performance on R2M-Bench. It also leads on all four consistency metrics for off-screen subject reappearance, including clothing consistency of 4.09 versus 3.03 for the best baseline.
papers.summary_cn: 长时视频生成需保留不断增长的历史信息，但直接对全部历史token条件化代价高昂，现有压缩方法易丢失信息。为此提出ReCam：将历史潜变量的局部时空块分组为向量并直接投影到扩散Transformer的高维隐空间，模型通过原生自注意力利用这些记忆token，在减少token数量的同时保留对完整历史的块级访问；并设计双指针去噪，为近期上下文与目标帧采用独立噪声调度以缓解自回归 rollout 中的时序漂移。ReCam在VBench-Long上取得最高总分80.1，在R2M-Bench静态场景重访上表现有竞争力，离屏主体重现的四项一致性指标全部领先，服装一致性达4.09，优于最佳基线的3.03。

papers.title: PixelSR: Pixel-Space Orthogonal Flow Decoupling for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Xiang Lv, Kai Zhao, Qiang Wang, Qiao Mo, Chao Zhou, Mingwen Shao
papers.abstract: Latent diffusion models have recently achieved remarkable progress in Real-world Image Super-Resolution (Real-SR). However, existing methods consistently exhibit a persistent seesaw effect: enhancing perceptual realism compromises structural fidelity. This effect, we argue, is not intrinsic to diffusion models, but largely stems from the architectural constraints of prevailing two-stage frameworks. To address this challenge, we propose PixelSR, a novel single-stage Pixel Diffusion Transformer for Real-SR that operates directly in pixel space. Specifically, PixelSR consists of two core designs: Pixel-space Conditional Diffusion and Orthogonal Flow Decoupling. The former establishes an effective pixel-space restoration framework by integrating spatially aligned LR conditioning, visual semantic guidance, and lightweight texture refinement, thereby bypassing VAE compression and enabling end-to-end optimization directly in RGB space. Complementarily, the latter decomposes the asymmetric flow target into a low-rank semantic component and a noise-free orthogonal texture component. By routing these components to specialized branches, it achieves decoupled optimization with reduced mutual interference. Benefiting from these designs, our PixelSR restores perceptually realistic details while faithfully preserving structural content. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PixelSR not only achieves competitive performance, but also effectively mitigates the fidelity--realism seesaw effect.
papers.summary_cn: 针对真实世界超分中感知真实感与结构保真此消彼长的问题，提出单阶段像素空间扩散Transformer：以空间对齐低分辨率条件、视觉语义引导和轻量纹理细化直接在RGB空间端到端重建，绕过VAE压缩；并将非对称流目标分解为低秩语义分量与无噪正交纹理分量，经两个分支解耦优化，降低相互干扰，缓解跷跷板效应。

papers.title: FocusOVD: Geometric and Contextual Feature Refinement for Open-Vocabulary Small-Object Detection
papers.authors: Hanlin Kou, Beiqi Bai, Li Chen, Youjia Jing, Shupan Li, Mingyuan Jiu
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary object detection aims to detect both seen and unseen categories by leveraging the semantic knowledge of vision-language models. However, existing methods often struggle with small objects due to insufficient preservation of high-resolution details, ineffective information aggregation across feature levels, and limited region-level discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose FocusOVD, an open-vocabulary object detector that enhances small-object representations without modifying the frozen VLM backbone. FocusOVD introduces three complementary components: a Reweighted Cross-scale Feature Fusion module, which learns normalized level-wise weights to adaptively balance shallow appearance details and deep semantic cues during feature pyramid aggregation; a Residual Pinwheel-shaped Gated Convolution module, which strengthens local geometric responses in high-resolution features; and a Residual Convolutional Gated Linear Unit module, which suppresses background-dominated activations and enhances RoI discriminability before prediction. Extensive experiments on COCO-OVD and LVIS-OVD demonstrate the effectiveness of FocusOVD. On COCO-OVD, FocusOVD achieves a novel-category AP of 36.3%, outperforming CORA, UniDetector, and SAMP by 1.3%, 1.1%, and 1.5%, respectively; on LVIS-OVD, it achieves an overall AP of 33.7%, surpassing the strongest competing method by 0.6%. These results demonstrate the strong generalization ability of FocusOVD for open-vocabulary small-object detection.
papers.summary_cn: 开放词汇检测中小目标因高分辨率细节丢失、跨层融合不足和区域判别力弱而难检；FocusOVD不改冻结VLM主干，用加权跨尺度融合平衡浅层细节与深层语义，残差风车门控卷积增强局部几何，残差卷积GLU抑制背景并提升RoI判别；在COCO-OVD和LVIS-OVD上验证有效，所给摘要未含完整数值。

papers.title: On Maximum Clique and Maximum Consensus Formulations in Point Cloud Registration
papers.authors: Abolfazl Babanazari, Kaveh Fathian
papers.abstract: Maximum clique and maximum consensus are widely used formulations for robust point cloud registration in robotics. Maximum consensus seeks one transformation that aligns as many matches as possible, while maximum clique selects matches through pairwise distance tests. Maximum clique is often used as a substitute for or an approximation to maximum consensus, with empirical evidence suggesting a close relationship. However, how closely the two formulations agree is not fully understood. We study this relationship theoretically. We show that a maximum clique can have arbitrarily large alignment error and be arbitrarily larger than the maximum consensus set at any fixed positive tolerance, and derive geometric conditions that bound this error. When rotation is fixed, we derive sharp error bounds and tests that exactly characterize maximum consensus for the translation subproblem. Finally, we study group-$k$ consistency, which tests groups of $k$ matches, and determine the smallest group sizes that guarantee alignment error bounds independent of point cloud scale and geometry. These are $d+1$ for rotations and translations and $d+2$ when reflections are allowed, in dimensions $d\ge 2$. Interactive examples and proof verification using the Lean theorem prover are available at https://ariarobotics.github.io/mc-vs-mc-registration/.
papers.summary_cn: 针对鲁棒点云配准中最大团常被当作最大一致性近似、但二者差距缺乏理论保证的问题，系统建立两种建模的一致性理论：证明在任意正容差下最大团误差和规模都可任意大，并给出界定误差的几何条件；固定旋转时对平移子问题得到紧误差界与精确判据；进一步用k元一致性检验确定与尺度和几何无关的最小组规模，d≥2维旋转平移为d+1、含反射为d+2。

papers.title: SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration
papers.authors: Javad Rajabi, Hakki Can Karaimer, David B. Lindell, Babak Taati, Michael S. Brown
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but they suffer from substantial inference costs due to repeated transformer evaluations across many denoising steps. Feature caching reduces this cost by reusing features across denoising steps. Recent forecasting methods extend this idea by extrapolating features to skipped steps instead of reusing them. However, existing forecasting methods extrapolate the features they predict uniformly, even though the spatial-frequency components of these features change most at different stages of denoising. They also overlook that denoising progresses nonuniformly, so equal step intervals can correspond to very different amounts of change. These mismatches amplify forecast errors as more steps are skipped, limiting the achievable acceleration. We propose SpecKCast, a training-free method that forecasts the model output in the frequency domain. SpecKCast applies a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT) to the output and tracks each coefficient with a lightweight Kalman filter along a band-specific time coordinate derived from the noise schedule. The filter tracks each coefficient's value and rate of change, and the transformer is evaluated only when the filter's forecast uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo show that SpecKCast achieves a better trade-off between acceleration and fidelity than existing caching and forecasting methods, reaching up to 6x speedup with less than 0.05 GiB of additional memory.
papers.summary_cn: 面向扩散变换器多步去噪带来的高推理成本，指出特征缓存与外推忽视各频率成分在不同去噪阶段变化不均、且步进本身非均匀，跳步越多误差越大。核心是无训练频域预测：对输出做二维离散余弦变换，按噪声日程构造频带专属时间坐标，用轻量卡尔曼滤波跟踪各系数的取值与变化率并外推跳过步，以降低计算同时保真；所给文本未含可核验加速或质量数字。

papers.title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
papers.authors: Kaiwei Chen, Moran Li, Zhenye Gan, Yabiao Wang, Chengjie Wang, Kexin Zhang, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws. Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself. We introduce PVBench, a physical video benchmark that quantitatively measures the plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions organized into seven domains, spanning: i) instruction and semantic fidelity, ii) behavioral and causal consistency, iii) perceptual and temporal quality, iv) geometric and spatial consistency, v) material properties and field states, vi) kinematic and spatiotemporal persistence, vii) and mechanical plausibility with conservation laws. PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems. For challenging physically tractable dimensions, it pairs each with specialized vision models that derive verifiable, physically grounded measurements, such as object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and numerical conservation-law residuals. It thus avoids relying solely on subjective scoring, while supporting both text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Finally, we validate the agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments through human evaluation. Meanwhile, we evaluate mainstream open-source and closed-source models and present several insights. By releasing the benchmark, prompts, and calibration protocol, we aim to foster physically grounded video generation.
papers.summary_cn: 当前视频生成模型虽视觉逼真，但物理合理性缺乏有效度量。为此提出PVBench物理视频基准，从指令语义、因果一致性、几何空间、运动学及守恒定律等七个领域共46个维度定量评估生成视频的物理可信性。基准包含600条精心设计的提示，其中30%涉及机械臂、人形机器人等物理具身智能体，并结合专用视觉模型输出可验证的物体级测量，如6D位姿等，实现对物理规律的客观量化评估。

papers.title: ALIGN: Aligning Condition Estimation and Expression in Advantage-Conditioned Behavior Cloning
papers.authors: Zechen Wang, Zhenqi Qiu, Houlong Xiong, Suohang Zhang, Yiyu Ren, Wanting Xu, Hongfei Niu, Chengyang He, Ge Sun, Ran Cheng, Qian Zhu
papers.abstract: Human-collected robot manipulation data often mix successful behavior with retries, pauses, recoveries, and failures. Advantage-Conditioned Behavior Cloning (AC-BC) can exploit such mixed-quality data, but only if the conditioning signal is both accurately constructed from offline trajectories and effectively incorporated into the policy's action-vector-field prediction. Existing pipelines can weaken this signal by thresholding estimator-derived advantage scores into noisy conditions, and by routing conditions through prompts that weakly affect the action vector field. We introduce ALIGN, a condition-aligned AC-BC framework for vision-language-action policies. ALIGN directly predicts categorical pairwise conditions in the policy-facing label space and injects them into a DiT action expert through AdaRMS modulation fused with flow time. We evaluate ALIGN on deliberately mixed real-robot datasets for ARX X5 bowl stacking and Franka key hanging, each combining standard demonstrations with retry-heavy trajectories. ALIGN improves condition fidelity, strengthens conditional vector-field separability, and achieves 90.0% and 56.7% closed-loop success, compared with 56.7% and 33.3% for the strongest AC-BC baseline. These results indicate that aligning conditions from estimation to action prediction is an effective way to extract robust manipulation policies from data in which success, recovery and error coexist.
papers.summary_cn: 针对人工采集机器人数据混杂成功与重试、失败等低质行为的问题，现有优势条件行为克隆因优势分数被阈值化为噪声条件、且条件经提示注入对动作向量场作用弱而受限。ALIGN 直接在策略标签空间预测成对分类条件，并经与流时间融合的 AdaRMS 调制注入 DiT 动作专家。在叠碗与挂钥匙任务上闭环成功率达 90.0% 和 56.7%，高于基线的 56.7% 和 33.3%。

papers.title: Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Yuanyu He, Zhuokun Chen, Yefei He, Zhiwei Tang, Jiasheng Tang, Yinghao Yu, Jianfei Cai, Bohan Zhuang
papers.abstract: Autoregressive Diffusion Transformers have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, they are often constrained by prohibitive computational overhead and substantial memory footprints. This inefficiency arises from dense computation mechanisms that allocate uniform processing resources across all spatiotemporal regions, failing to leverage the inherent temporal redundancy of video where motion is typically confined to sparse areas. In this paper, we propose Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention (DASA), a unified framework that shifts from dense computation to sparse, motion-driven generation to eliminate both storage and computational redundancies. Inspired by video codec principles, our approach explicitly decouples video content into dynamic and static regions. To mitigate memory bottlenecks, we selectively compress the historical KV cache by retaining only dynamic features within the generated chunk. Furthermore, to reduce computational overhead, we employ a region-level computation allocation strategy based on localized dynamics. Additionally, a dynamics-guided distillation method is introduced to enhance performance via a lightweight distillation training process. Experiments on VBench demonstrate that our approach accelerates autoregressive video generation by 2.16x, while preserving high visual fidelity.
papers.summary_cn: 针对长视频自回归扩散生成中密集注意力带来的高算力与显存冗余，提出按运动稀疏分配资源的统一框架：借鉴编解码思想解耦动静区域，仅保留生成块内动态特征压缩历史缓存，并按局部动态做区域级计算分配，再以动态引导的轻量蒸馏提升性能，在维持质量的同时显著降低存储与计算成本。

papers.title: RECAP: Reciprocal Sparse Attention and Hierarchical Caching for Efficient Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Tiange Xu, Kai Liu, Linghe Kong, Yulun Zhang
papers.abstract: Diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos but remain computationally expensive. Sparse attention and temporal caching reduce computation within and across denoising steps, respectively, offering a natural composition. However, predictions produced with sparse attention become sources for temporal reuse, coupling their errors along the sampling trajectory. We observe that improving the accuracy of these sources recovers fidelity without changing the reuse schedule, and that sparsification errors remain directionally aligned across nearby steps, suggesting that correction information can be shared rather than recomputed. These observations motivate RECAP, a training-free method that couples sparse attention with hierarchical caching through reciprocal correction, adaptively coordinated by online error feedback. Cached dense refinement corrects omitted interactions in current sparse estimates, while fresh sparse statistics track input changes and regulate the aging correction. The resulting predictions then renew the sources for whole-step prediction reuse, allowing prediction history to advance between dense refreshes. We evaluate RECAP on multiple video diffusion models against sparse-attention methods, caching methods, and their direct compositions. On HunyuanVideo at 720p 5-second generation, RECAP achieves a 3.05x speedup and outperforms all tested direct compositions in both fidelity and inference speed.
papers.summary_cn: 面向视频扩散 transformer 推理昂贵、稀疏注意与跨步缓存简单叠加会沿采样轨迹耦合误差的问题，RECAP 以免训练方式把二者用互惠校正连接：缓存的稠密修正补回稀疏估计遗漏的交互，新鲜稀疏统计感知输入变化并抑制老化修正，在线误差反馈自适应调度，使整步预测历史在稠密刷新间推进；在多个视频扩散模型上无需重训即恢复保真并降低计算。

papers.title: PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for Zero-Shot 6D Object Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Emirkan Burak Yilmaz, Yakup Genc
papers.abstract: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer.
papers.summary_cn: 针对零样本六维位姿估计中传统PnP-RANSAC迭代且不可微的局限，构建免迭代可微神经位姿求解器，把半稠密二维三维对应场与置信度映射到连续隐空间后直接回归位姿，并与对应模块分开训练。在BOP七个核心数据集上平均AR为41.2%、单目标0.46秒，高于RayPose的39.1%但低于Co-op的58.4%；换用EPnP-RANSAC升至52.2%、多耗60毫秒，呈精度延迟权衡。

papers.title: TamedFlow: Trajectory-Aware Distillation for Teacher-Assisted Diffusion Sampling
papers.authors: Shuaiqi Cheng, Jiahao Zhang, Boyuan Gu, Yuxi Chen, Haiying Xu, Zexin Lu, Huiyu Zhou, Xuming Hu
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. We propose \textbf{TamedFlow}, which trains a compressed DiT for this deployed role through cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision. At inference, a lightweight Learnable Trajectory Estimator routes completed drafts: accepted drafts bypass the teacher, while rejected drafts roll back and receive one teacher rescue step. Distilling DiT-XL/2 into DiT-B/2, TamedFlow reaches FID $2.58$ at $2.25\times$ measured speedup over DDIM-50 on ImageNet $256\times256$. Ablations support trajectory supervision, and routing controls favor LTE over random decisions at nearly matched latency. Evaluations on ImageNet $512\times512$, MS-COCO, and Latte/FaceForensics extend the empirical scope.
papers.summary_cn: 针对扩散Transformer推理需多次串行求值、压缩与自适应推理直接叠加易失效的组合缺口，方法用跨架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头和随机展开监督训练学生，并以可学习轨迹估计器决定草稿绕过教师或回滚接受一次教师救援；DiT-XL/2蒸馏到DiT-B/2时FID降至2左右，兼顾保真与加速。

papers.title: OV-PEAR: Observation-Verified Pose-Scale Estimation and Reconstruction for Unknown Industrial Manipulation Objects
papers.authors: Guoqin Tang, Qingxuan Jia, Yichen Tan, Zihang Lv, Ruiquan Wang, Zeyuan Huang, Gang Chen
papers.abstract: Fine industrial robotic manipulation requires 6D pose, scale, and an operation-ready 3D model. Existing industrial pose estimation relies on CAD models, object-specific training data, or stable workcells, limiting use with unseen objects; zero-shot methods suffer from single-view occlusion, generative bias, and scale uncertainty. We present OV-PEAR, an observation-verified framework for 3D reconstruction and pose-scale estimation of unknown industrial objects. Its three-stage object-centric pipeline: (1) segments RGB-D instances and generates object-level 3D hypotheses; (2) anchors them to the robot frame via appearance-aware view retrieval, explicit scale search, and visibility-sensitive registration; (3) back-projects multi-view RGB-D evidence into the object-canonical frame to verify voxel occupancy, suppress hallucinations, and produce reusable trusted object models. On BOP-Industrial, OV-PEAR achieves 0.657 average AR and improves pose and voxel-level geometric consistency in real scenes; real-robot connector assembly reaches 99.67% grasp and 84.00% assembly success. The model library and pose-scale log enable short-term object-level state maintenance at 0.02 ms/frame.
papers.summary_cn: 针对未知工业物体的6D位姿、尺度估计与可操作三维建模问题，现有方法依赖CAD模型或单物体训练数据，且零样本方法存在遮挡、生成偏差与尺度不确定等局限，为此提出观测验证框架OV-PEAR。其三阶段流程：分割RGB-D实例并生成物体级三维假设；通过外观感知视角检索、显式尺度搜索与可见性敏感配准将其锚定到机器人坐标系；再将多视角RGB-D证据反投影至物体规范系验证体素占据、抑制幻觉。在BOP-Industrial上平均AR达0.657，真实机器人接插件装配抓取成功率99.67%、装配成功率84.00%，物体级状态维护仅需0.02毫秒每帧。

papers.title: Negation without Confusion: Decomposing Bias and Recomposing Style in Text Embeddings for Negation-aware Image Generation
papers.authors: Sooyeon Park, Hemraj Singh, Kyunghyun Min, Youngjae Yu, Sung-Bae Cho
papers.abstract: Negation-aware image generation remains challenging for text-to-image diffusion models, which often struggle with negation due to implicit linguistic biases that are deeply entangled within text representations. As a result, bias-aligned semantics frequently dominate over intended negative constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose a simple training-free method of Decompose and Recompose text embedding (Dero), which constructs a semantic-preserving subspace and a bias subspace using auxiliary prompts and performs semantic disentanglement based on bidirectional SVD. By decomposing entangled representations and selectively recomposing disentangled semantic components, Dero realigns text representations toward intended negation semantics while restoring residual stylistic features to preserve semantic fidelity and image quality. As a model-agnostic inference-time framework operating solely on text representations, Dero can be seamlessly applied to diverse diffusion architectures, including both U-Net and DiT based models. Extensive experiments on both object- and concept-level negation demonstrate consistent improvements in negation-aware image generation, achieving stronger text-image alignment, better semantic fidelity, and higher human preference scores.
papers.summary_cn: 针对文生图扩散模型难以处理否定、隐性语言偏置与语义纠缠并压过否定约束的问题，Dero 借辅助提示构建语义保持子空间与偏置子空间，以双向 SVD 解耦后重组否定语义并回补风格残差；方法免训练、模型无关，适配 U-Net 与 DiT，在物体和概念级否定上稳定提升可控性与画质。

papers.title: DexGraspFlow: Topology-Aware SE(3) Flow Matching for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
papers.authors: Bin Zhou, Boyu Ma, Xinyu Zhou, Jiahua Dong, Chuhao Zhou, Yizhou Liu, Hao Wan, Jianfei Yang
papers.abstract: Differences in hand geometry, joint parameterization, and kinematic topology pose challenges for cross-embodiment dexterous grasp generation. However, spatial relations among links alone are insufficient to fully capture the hand's kinematic topology. We propose DexGraspFlow, a conditional link-level $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ flow-matching framework integrating geometric relations and kinematic topology. The framework encodes local object geometry, link geometry, and current poses. A dual-stream DiT models link--link coordination and link--object interaction, while attention biases derived from kinematic-tree distances provide explicit structural information for modeling evolving geometric interactions. The model jointly learns translational and rotational velocity fields, integrates them to generate link poses, and recovers joint configurations through inverse kinematics. Additionally, inference-time palm-orientation guidance enables controllable grasp generation without retraining. Across three robotic hands and 30 object--hand pairs, DexGraspFlow achieves a 95.33\% average simulation success rate, with an average generation latency, including inverse kinematics, approximately 49\% lower than that of a state-of-the-art baseline. Further experiments demonstrate zero-shot adaptability to seven finger-removal variants and palm-orientation control. A model trained on demonstrations for the deployed hand achieves a 91\% success rate over 100 real-robot grasping trials, supporting the framework's applicability to physical grasp execution.
papers.summary_cn: 针对灵巧手在手部几何、关节参数化与运动学拓扑上的差异导致的跨本体抓取生成难题，提出 DexGraspFlow：一种条件化的连杆级 SE(3) 流匹配框架，融合几何关系与运动学拓扑信息。该框架编码物体局部几何、连杆几何与当前位姿，利用双流 DiT 建模连杆间协调及连杆与物体交互，并以运动学树距离构造注意力偏置注入结构先验；联合学习平移与旋转速度场生成连杆位姿，再经逆运动学恢复关节角，推理时还可通过手掌朝向引导实现免重训的可控抓取。在三种机械手与 30 组物体-手配对上取得 95.33% 的平均仿真成功率，含逆运动学的平均生成延迟降低约 49%。

papers.title: ViMoLa: Discrete Motion Tokens for Language-Guided Video Generation
papers.authors: Bishoy Galoaa, Sarah Ostadabbas
papers.abstract: Language-guided video generation often captures scene content while missing the requested motion. We present ViMoLa (Video Motion Language), which predicts a motion prior from language and injects it into a frozen image-to-video backbone. A spatial vector-quantized autoencoder compresses dense trajectories into 64 tokens from a 512-entry codebook; a 28M-parameter transformer predicts the tokens from text; and zero-gated cross-attention adapters condition every frozen Wan~2.2 DiT block through forward hooks. Trained on 462K videos from Something-Something~v2 and Kinetics-400, ViMoLa raises directional accuracy from 0.287 to 0.442 (chance 0.250), with similar measured generative quality. Across-prompt shuffled codes achieve 0.283, supporting the importance of prompt-matched token content. A low-rank adapter reaches 0.428 at 1.45% additional forward-pass FLOPs, and reusing the tokenizer and language model with newly trained CogVideoX adapters raises accuracy from 0.301 to 0.398. Control remains imperfect: oracle codes reach 0.531, compound-motion gains are smaller, and the adapter does not explicitly preserve token-to-patch assignments.
papers.summary_cn: 针对语言引导视频生成中运动指令常被忽略的问题，ViMoLa 先从文本预测运动先验再注入冻结的图生视频骨干网络：向量量化自编码器将稠密轨迹压缩为来自512码本的64个离散运动令牌，2800万参数Transformer据文本预测令牌，并通过零门控交叉注意力适配器条件化Wan 2.2各DiT块。在46.2万视频上训练后，方向准确率由0.287提升至0.442（随机水平0.250），生成质量相当；低秩适配器仅增1.45%算力即达0.428，迁移至CogVideoX亦将准确率由0.301提升至0.398，但复合运动控制仍有限。

papers.title: SL-Ground: Sentence-Level Grounding for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
papers.authors: Yang-Syu Li, Cheng-Huan Yang, Chia-Yung Jui, Peggy Joy Lu
papers.abstract: Grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors provide a widely used framework for text-conditioned localization, with a phrase-grounding formulation that aligns object queries to individual text tokens and recovers class scores through token-to-class aggregation. We observe that this token-level scoring design becomes a bottleneck for fine-grained open-vocabulary object detection, where the target category is defined by a complete compositional description rather than by isolated tokens. Based on this observation, we propose SL-Ground, a sentence-level grounding reformulation for grounding-based open-vocabulary detection. Instead of scoring queries against fragmented token evidence, SL-Ground encodes each category description as a complete sentence-level representation and directly scores object queries against these representations. To evaluate fine-grained recognition across label granularity, we construct a multi-granularity Stanford Cars benchmark spanning vehicle type, brand, and car model. At the finest car-model granularity, SL-Ground raises AP over the token-level variant from 14.5 to 70.6 under matched training candidate sampling and to 86.0 with full-vocabulary training, while better preserving open-vocabulary capability and avoiding repeated prompt chunking. Beyond Stanford Cars, SL-Ground also improves FG-OVD performance, achieving the best average AP among compared methods. These results show that sentence-level grounding provides a more suitable scoring unit for fine-grained OVOD and offers a practical path toward fine-grained grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors.
papers.summary_cn: 针对细粒度开放词汇检测中，短语定位按文本词元打分再聚合类别、难以表达完整组合类别的问题，提出SL-Ground：将类别描述编码为句子级表示，让目标查询直接与其匹配打分。构建覆盖车型、品牌、车款的多粒度Stanford Cars基准；最细车款粒度上，AP由14.5升至70.6，全词表训练达86.0。

papers.title: Landmark-Free and Scale-Blind Multi-View Registration of Preoperative Liver Models to Intraoperative Surfaces
papers.authors: Jiaming Feng, Gerardo Loza Galindo, Shahid Farid, Sharib Ali
papers.abstract: Augmented-reality guidance in laparoscopic liver resection requires aligning preoperative 3D liver models from CT/MRI with intraoperative surfaces. Monocular reconstruction in most cases cannot guarantee scale, albeit rigid-motion registration requires scale as an input.
