Our proposed framework ``SimCompose'' estimates the full similarity transformation $\Sim$, including scale, without relying on landmarks and applies the same transformation across multiple views with known relative geometry. However, reliable detection of registration failures remains challenging in surgical settings, where ground-truth alignment is generally unavailable. For this, we propose a geometry-based selector that evaluates candidate transformations without requiring ground truth. Large disagreement among these transformations is used to flag potentially unreliable registrations. Finally, we propose to use a non-rigid refinement based on a low-dimensional deformation model from Neo-Hookean simulations in the Simulation Open Framework Architecture (SOFA), without additional network training. SimCompose is trained exclusively on synthetic partial views. Its encoder processes point clouds normalised to a unit root-mean-square radius, without access to metric scale, and filters each view before multi-view fusion. Evaluation on unseen synthetic data (300 single-view pairs per run; 100 three-view registrations) shows that multi-view integration and candidate selection increase the success rate under stringent $\Sim$ accuracy criteria from 38.4% for a single-view, single-method configuration to 77%. Existing learning-based baselines do not satisfy these criteria even when provided with the exact scale. On five in-vivo patients with 92 keyframes, the rigid registration stage reduces surface error more than three-fold relative to learning-based baselines with external scale information.
papers.summary_cn: 面向腹腔镜肝切除增强现实导航，解决术前CT/MRI三维肝模型到术中单目重建表面的尺度未知、无标志点配准及失败难检测问题。SimCompose统一估计含尺度的相似变换，并在已知相对几何的多视角间共用；几何选择器依据候选变换分歧在无真值下标记不可靠配准，再以SOFA的Neo-Hookean低维形变做免训练非刚性细化。模型仅用合成部分点云训练，输入归一化到单位尺度。

papers.title: CLARO: Clutter Aware Robot Orchestrator for Open-Vocabulary Grasping using VLM Agents
papers.authors: Sungsu Kim, Vineet Bhat, Prashanth Krishnamurthy, Ramesh Karri, Farshad Khorrami
papers.abstract: Robots that follow natural-language instructions unlock a wide range of autonomous applications in households, warehouses, and labs. Real-world environments are diverse and often heavily cluttered, requiring robots to plan over multiple steps, act, and replan as they work toward a goal. We present CLARO (CLutter-Aware Robot Orchestrator), a VLM agent that orchestrates a set of perception and manipulation skills: open-vocabulary object detection, segmentation, 6-DoF grasping, and non-prehensile pushing to locate and retrieve a language-specified target in clutter. CLARO maintains a memory of its past actions to support long-horizon execution, and emits manipulation targets (grasp poses/3D waypoints) allowing transfer across robot arms without task-specific training. We evaluate CLARO against a range of methods on a dynamic simulation environment and standard image-based benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization across object classes, lighting, and clutter levels. CLARO attains an average success rate of 89.1%, a relative improvement of over 16% on the strongest competing method in high cluttered scenes. We further analyze performance along grounding and grasping axes to characterize where each method succeeds and fails. Finally, we deploy CLARO on a robot arm across diverse cluttered scenes, achieving a success rate of 88.8%, and demonstrating strong sim2real generalizability.
papers.summary_cn: 针对杂乱环境中机器人需按自然语言指令多步规划、执行并重规划以抓取目标的问题，提出视觉语言模型智能体 CLARO，统一调度开放词汇检测、分割、六自由度抓取及非抓取式推拨等技能，并维护动作记忆支持长程任务，输出抓取位姿和三维路径点从而无需任务特定训练即可迁移到不同机械臂。在动态仿真与标准基准上，其对物体类别、光照和杂乱程度泛化良好，平均成功率达 89.1%，在高杂乱场景中较最强基线相对提升超 16%。

papers.title: Rethinking the design space of Vanilla Pixel Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Soumik Mukhopadhyay, Long Mai, Abhinav Shrivastava, Aniruddha Mahapatra
papers.abstract: Pixel-space diffusion models have recently re-emerged as a compelling alternative to latent diffusion, avoiding the lossy latent bottleneck and separately trained autoencoder. JiT shows that a vanilla diffusion transformer can generate directly in pixel space by replacing the commonly used velocity prediction ($\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction) with clean image prediction ($\boldsymbol{x_0}$-prediction). In this work, we revisit this choice and introduce MFlow, an adaptive parameterization that learns to interpolate between $\boldsymbol{x_0}$- and $\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction across principal directions of the data, learned end-to-end with diffusion training. We find that the preferred parameterization varies systematically with the data representation and model capacity -- notably, increasing model capacity shifts preference toward velocity prediction. We evaluate MFlow across ImageNet, UCF-101 video, and large-scale text-to-image generation, demonstrating competitive or improved generative performance across diverse settings. In addition, we find that vanilla pixel diffusion transformers, irrespective of parameterization, retain a persistent high-frequency deficit relative to real images. To address this, we introduce ConvRefiner, a lightweight convolutional module trained post-hoc with an adversarial loss while keeping the diffusion backbone frozen. With only a small amount of additional training, ConvRefiner restores the high-frequency statistics of generated images while preserving FID. Project webpage: https://soumik-kanad.github.io/mflow-diffusion/.
papers.summary_cn: 针对像素空间扩散模型中预测参数化方式的选择问题，重新审视JiT采用的干净图像预测与常用的速度预测之间的取舍，提出MFlow自适应参数化方法，在扩散训练中端到端地学习沿数据主方向在两种预测方式间插值。实验发现最优参数化随数据表示与模型容量系统性变化，容量增大时更偏向速度预测。该方法在ImageNet、UCF-101视频生成及大规模文生图任务上均取得有竞争力或更优的生成性能，同时揭示纯像素扩散Transformer普遍存在高频细节缺失问题。

papers.title: Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models
papers.authors: Yuze He, Bin Tan, Zelin Gao, Yujun Shen, Yong-Jin Liu, Nan Xue, Yinghao Xu
papers.abstract: Video world models that generate and explore environments at scale need a persistent 3D memory of what they have produced. Plane primitives offer a natural candidate: a compact set of oriented planes captures the dominant structural elements (e.g., walls, floors, facades) of indoor and outdoor scenes, while requiring only 7 parameters per primitive. We present PPMem, a video world model that adopts plane primitives as its persistent 3D memory. PPMem augments a video diffusion transformer with a planar prediction head and a Depth Token Fusion (DTF) module: each autoregressive chunk jointly produces RGB video and planar geometry, which merges into a persistent plane memory that conditions subsequent chunks via rendered depth. The resulting memory is three orders of magnitude more compact than per-pixel point clouds (~100K primitives, 5MB for a full scene), geometrically explicit (metric depth, normals, exportable surfaces), cross-view consistent (jointly predicted by the shared backbone), and adaptive (refined by the merging procedure as generation proceeds). On DL3DV and RealEstate10K, PPMem outperforms prior 3D-grounded world models in video quality while jointly producing metric-scale depth, surface normals, and exportable planar geometry, sustaining coherence across hundreds of frames under large viewpoint changes. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/ppmem.
papers.summary_cn: 视频世界模型在大规模生成与探索场景时需要持久的三维记忆。PPMem 以平面基元作为持久三维记忆，每个基元仅需7个参数即可刻画墙面、地面等主要结构。方法在视频扩散变换器上增加平面预测头与深度令牌融合模块，自回归生成视频块的同时联合输出RGB与平面几何，逐步合并为持久平面记忆并通过渲染深度约束后续生成。该记忆比逐像素点云紧凑三个数量级，完整场景约10万个基元仅5MB，且具备度量深度、跨视角一致性。在DL3DV和RealEstate10K上，视频质量优于以往三维世界模型。

papers.title: LiveSync: Iterative Self-Training for Lip-Sync Generation
papers.authors: Huaishao Luo, Huan Zhang, Guanbo Bao, Yinglu Liu, Youzheng Wu, Xiaodong He
papers.abstract: Audio-driven lip synchronization aims to match target speech through localized mouth and jaw articulation while preserving subject identity, head pose, and surrounding facial context. Naturally recorded videos provide synchronized reconstruction targets but rarely offer pairs that are matched in identity and pose yet differ primarily in speech-related articulation. Mask-based training enables reconstruction from these videos, but random-reference inputs differ from the aligned self-reference used at inference. We present LiveSync, an iterative self-training framework in which a single mask-based model generates pseudo pairs and is refined for deployment. The model is first trained on a curated real-video corpus augmented with externally generated clips covering under-represented visual conditions. A frozen checkpoint then uses independently sampled audio to generate mouth-edited references from real-video frames, copying pixels outside the edit mask from each source frame. After confidence filtering, these references are paired with aligned masked inputs and original real-frame targets. The retained pseudo pairs are mixed with real training data to refine the same model from its current weights, updating training supervision without adding inference stages. Although we instantiate the framework with a single-pass GAN-based model, the self-training strategy could in principle also be adapted to diffusion-based models. Experimental results show that LiveSync achieves leading synchronization performance on HDTF and competitive performance compared with the baselines on the AIGC-LipSync subset, while maintaining low inference latency.
papers.summary_cn: 面向音频驱动唇形同步中身份姿态一致而口型不同的配对稀缺、训练随机参考与推理自参考不一致的问题，LiveSync用单个遮罩模型迭代自训练：先以真实视频和外部生成稀缺条件片段训练，再用冻结 checkpoint 采样音频生成嘴部编辑伪参考，经置信过滤后与对齐遮罩输入及真实目标混合精调，缓解分布偏移并提升部署一致性。

papers.title: MOSS-Image Technical Report
papers.authors: MOSI. AI
papers.abstract: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
papers.summary_cn: 针对开源文生图模型在密集文字渲染与复杂版面控制上的不足，MOSS-Image 从零预训练 5B 单流扩散 Transformer，支持中英文长文本渲染与精确版面控制，并设计意图感知的智能体提示增强模块，将用户请求转化为详细内容与版面规格。同时提出长文本评测基准 LLTB 与端到端版面评测 RLA。MOSS-Image 在 LLTB 上取得开源权重模型最优性能，平均文本覆盖率达 96.3%，在 RLA 端到端系统对比中位列第二，其骨干模型排名第一。

papers.title: DIFFLET: A Fast Inference Engine for Diffusion Transformer Models on AWS Trainium
papers.authors: Bin Ma, Min Yu, Vijay Kodamalla, Jonny Liu, Da Li, Dong Li
papers.abstract: On AWS Trainium2, every component of a diffusion model runs as a program compiled ahead of time for fixed shapes, while pipelines differ across models, prompt lengths across requests, and caching decisions across denoising steps. We present Difflet, a serving engine in which five model pipelines share one compilation backend, joint attention is split across cores by attention head, and a host controller decides at each denoising step whether to run the denoiser or reuse its earlier output. A small probe program computes the caching signal on the device and returns one number per step, and a resident model process keeps every program loaded across requests. Across five image and video model families, fused attention accelerates denoiser steps by 1.2-4.3x over the same framework using PyTorch/XLA attention, and at 32.8k visual tokens it is the only attention that compiles. On four of the five models, resident serving is 1.5-3.4x faster than standalone runs that reload weights from a warm file cache for each generation.
papers.summary_cn: 针对 AWS Trainium2 上扩散模型推理需预编译固定形状、但流水线、提示长度与缓存决策多变的问题，Difflet 让五条模型流水线共享同一编译后端，按注意力头将联合注意力切分到多核，并由主机控制器每步决定运行去噪器还是复用历史输出，小型探针程序在设备端计算缓存信号，常驻进程保持程序加载。在五个图像与视频模型上，融合注意力使去噪步加速 1.2-4.3 倍，且在 32.8k 视觉 token 下唯一能编译；常驻服务在其中四个模型上比重载权重的独立运行快 1.5-3.4 倍。

papers.title: Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention for Efficient Inference in T2I/T2V Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Bingxin Xing, Yu Zhang, Jiatong Ding, Lei Lu, Ping Wang
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a common backbone for high-quality text-to-image and text-to-video generation, but repeated dense self-attention remains a major inference bottleneck as token sequences grow and the same operator is invoked across many denoising steps. Our study suggests that dense attention in pretrained DiTs contains reusable layer/head-specific high-mass structure that can be identified from a small offline calibration set and reused across future generations. This leads to Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention, a train-free attention replacement that reuses static sink masks and supplements them with a lightweight pooled-KV branch, while leaving model weights and sampling schedules unchanged. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, the method attains 1.54$\times$ end-to-end speedup while maintaining generation quality. On Z-Image-Turbo, it attains 1.57$\times$ end-to-end speedup with competitive GenEval2 performance. These results indicate that reusable importance-aware sparse support can provide an effective train-free acceleration path for both T2V and T2I DiTs.
papers.summary_cn: 针对文生图与文生视频扩散Transformer中，密集自注意力随序列变长和多次去噪调用造成的推理瓶颈，利用预训练模型中可离线校准识别、跨生成复用的层/头特异高重要性结构，提出免训练的Sink-Sparse混合注意力：复用静态sink掩码并补充轻量pooled-KV分支，不改权重与采样调度。在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上端到端加速1.54倍且质量基本保持，在Z-Image-Turbo上加速1.57倍，GenEval2表现有竞争力。

papers.title: Learning to Be Guided: Shaping Latent Geometry for Classifier-Free Guidance
papers.authors: Haoming Liu, Junhao Zhu, Shaoyi Zheng, Yuanhe Guo, Jinnuo Liu, Shenji Wan, Hongyi Wen
papers.abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard component of conditional diffusion models, and guided generation performance has become the \textit{de facto} measure of state-of-the-art models. Recent work on latent diffusion models seeks to learn latent spaces that are easier to model with diffusion. However, under CFG, generation additionally depends on how conditions are arranged in the latent space. We study this arrangement under discrete class conditions, termed \emph{class geometry}, and investigate what class geometry allows a latent space to work well with CFG. Under a Gaussian class model, we show that shifting variance from intra- to inter-class at fixed total variance makes classes more distinguishable under noise, and derive a noisy posterior objective whose per-sample descent direction is proportional to the oracle CFG correction. Based on the analysis, we propose Prototype Regularization (PR), a lightweight surrogate for the intractable noisy posterior objective, which applies a cosine prototype classifier to spatially pooled latents. With a controlled training budget (20 epochs for VAE, 80 epochs for DiT), adding PR to an LDM baseline reduces guided gFID on ImageNet from 3.31 to 2.28, surpassing a DINOv3-aligned VA-VAE (2.44) with negligible overhead. We further demonstrate that PR generalizes to pseudo-labels derived from clustering, continuous text-embedding conditions, and video latents. Together, our findings highlight class geometry as a critical factor in guided generation and take a first step toward CFG-compatible representation learning. Our project page is available at: https://maps-research.github.io/cfg-geometry/.
papers.summary_cn: 针对无分类器引导扩散生成中条件类别在潜空间的排布影响引导效果的问题，分析类内与类间方差的作用，表明在总方差固定时将方差由类内转向类间可增强噪声下的类别区分度，并提出原型正则化，以余弦原型分类器近似难计算的噪声后验目标。在VAE训练20轮、DiT训练80轮的受控预算下，该方法降低了潜扩散基线在ImageNet上的引导条件gFID。

papers.title: OmniXRef: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Multi-Reference Video Editing
papers.authors: Xiaoyan Cong, Tianyu Wang, Hyeonho Jeong, Zhifei Zhang, Yuqian Zhou, Yijun Li, Shaoteng Liu, Zhe Lin, Srinath Sridhar, Soo Ye Kim
papers.abstract: Creative intent in video editing can be expressed through text instructions (e.g., "remove the people"), image references (e.g., subject appearance), video references (e.g., camera movement), or a combination of the above. We introduce OmniXRef, a unified framework for multimodal multi-reference video editing that allows users to combine variable numbers of text, image, and video references to control diverse attributes of a source video. We first devise a unified input design with a reference-bank interface and introduce $R^2$-RoPE to support generalization to more references. Then our model, OmniXRef-Model, uses a single-stream diffusion transformer to jointly process the source video and multimodal context from an MLLM in an interleaved sequence. To address the scarcity of training data for video-reference editing, we construct OmniXRef-Data using synthesis pipelines for different editing tasks and combinations of references. We use curriculum learning to progressively increase task complexity and resolution. To support systematic evaluation of video as a control modality, we introduce OmniXRef-Bench, a benchmark for video-reference attribute transfer across Camera, Motion, Content, Style, and Visual Effects (VFX). Comprehensive evaluations show that our OmniXRef-Model outperforms task-specific baselines and commercial models.
papers.summary_cn: 针对视频编辑中文本、图像、视频等多种参考形式难以统一控制的问题，提出OmniXRef统一框架，允许用户灵活组合可变数量的多模态参考来操控源视频的不同属性。方法上设计参考库输入接口与R²-RoPE以支持更多参考的泛化，采用单流扩散Transformer联合处理源视频与MLLM提取的多模态上下文，并通过合成管线构建训练数据、用课程学习逐步提升任务复杂度与分辨率。同时提出OmniXRef-Bench基准，系统评估相机、运动等属性的视频参考迁移能力。

papers.title: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
papers.authors: Jung Hun Phee, Tucker Balch
papers.abstract: We study the conditional distribution of limit-order volume submitted over the next five minutes, given the current order book and recent order flow. The task requires capturing price placement, total volume, and predictive uncertainty jointly. Coordinate-wise diffusion losses do not explicitly account for price displacement, while normalizing fields to unit mass removes information about total volume. Agreement on selected summary statistics also does not establish fidelity to the joint field distribution. We introduce OrderFlowDiT, a conditional Diffusion Transformer for unnormalized bid and ask volume-at-price fields, trained with an unbalanced optimal-transport (UOT) auxiliary loss. We also develop a full-field evaluation framework that combines a transport cost sensitive to price placement and total volume with proper scoring rules and calibration diagnostics. In the primary comparison on 1950 validation conditions across 30 U.S. equities, adding UOT reduces full-field transport cost by 45.8% and the transport energy score by 26.1% relative to training with mean squared error alone. Both measures improve for every stock. These findings support incorporating price geometry and volume into generative modeling, with field accuracy and predictive uncertainty evaluated together.
papers.summary_cn: 针对限价订单簿未来五分钟内订单提交量的条件分布预测问题，需联合刻画价格位置、总量与预测不确定性。提出OrderFlowDiT，一种基于条件扩散Transformer的模型，直接建模未归一化的买卖两侧价格—成交量场，并引入非平衡最优传输辅助损失以显式融入价格几何信息；同时构建结合传输成本、评分规则与校准诊断的全场评估框架。在30只美股、1950个验证条件上，相比仅用均方误差训练，加入该损失使全场传输成本降低45.8%，传输能量评分下降26.1%，且所有股票均有改善。

papers.title: RTISSLAM-3D: Full 6-DoF SLAM With an In-Air 3D Imaging Sonar
papers.authors: Jan Steckel, Vincent Katter, Wouter Jansen
papers.abstract: Echolocating bats navigate dense forests using sonar alone, and in-air 3D imaging sonars now capture the entire frontal hemisphere with every pulse. Sonar SLAM, however, has so far been planar: current systems estimate a 2D trajectory and discard the elevation information in the sonar images, an assumption that does not hold on rough and sloped terrain such as a forest floor. In this paper, we introduce RTISSLAM-3D, a novel 6-DoF SLAM system for a wheeled robot that carries an in-air 3D imaging sonar, an IMU and wheel encoders. A CFAR detector on the sphere reduces every sonar image to a sparse set of 3D detections, which we use for a 3D acoustic odometry that models the shape of the sonar beam, for place recognition with polar submap descriptors, and for the verification of loop closures by 3D registration, all combined in a 6-DoF pose graph with attitude factors. We evaluated RTISSLAM-3D on a 545m drive through a forest, with a 3D lidar SLAM as reference. The loop closures reduced the horizontal error of the acoustic odometry from 1.74m to 0.28m, with a height error of 0.12m, and 94.6% of the resulting 3D sonar map lies within 0.3 m of the lidar map.
papers.summary_cn: 针对现有声呐SLAM仅估计平面轨迹、丢弃仰角信息而不适应起伏地形的问题，提出RTISSLAM-3D：一种基于空中三维成像声呐、IMU和轮式编码器的全6自由度SLAM系统。方法用CFAR检测将球面声呐图像压缩为稀疏三维检测点，结合声呐波束形状建模的三维声学里程计、极坐标子图描述子回环检测与三维配准验证，构建带姿态因子的位姿图。在545米森林实验中，回环将水平误差从1.74米降至0.28米，高度误差0.12米，94.6%的声呐地图与激光雷达地图偏差在0.3米内。

papers.title: Erase the Mark, Preserve the Motion: Temporally Consistent Removal of Video Watermarks
papers.authors: Yifan Liao, Zhen Sun, Zhicong Huang, Jiaming He, Zongmin Zhang, Xi Ai, Cheng Hong, Xinhu Zheng, Xinlei He
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video generation have increased the demand for reliable watermarking for copyright protection, yet the robustness of video watermarks against removal attacks remains underexplored. Most watermark-removal methods originate from the image domain: signal optimization injects imperceptible pixel-domain perturbations, whereas generative resynthesis produces a visually similar instance through diffusion synthesis. When extended to videos, the former introduces temporally varying noise that causes visible flickering, while the latter regenerates fine-grained structures inconsistently across frames, leading to structural motion inconsistency. To evaluate video watermark robustness, we propose PoseRegen, a pose-consistent reconstruction framework that removes watermarks while preserving the original content and motion. PoseRegen first applies a temporally shared viewpoint transformation to disrupt watermark-bearing spatial patterns and then jointly reconstructs the transformed sequence with a pose-conditioned video model. A frozen video DiT processes the complete sequence with its reference-video latent, and full-sequence Flow Matching supervision keeps identity and background consistent across frames. To further preserve motion structure, we introduce a lightweight Pose-Conditioned Motion Consistency Adapter that adapts the frozen backbone to temporally ordered pose guidance and constrains body-part trajectories throughout reconstruction. Experiments on eleven video watermarking schemes show that PoseRegen reduces the average bit accuracy to 0.505, near random guessing, while outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.34% on motion-related VBench metrics. These results reveal a practical vulnerability of current video watermarks and highlight the need to evaluate robustness jointly with temporal and motion quality.
papers.summary_cn: 针对视频生成普及下水印版权保护易受去除攻击、图像方法迁移到视频会产生闪烁与结构运动不一致的问题，提出PoseRegen：先做全序列共享的视角变换破坏水印空间模式，再用姿态条件视频模型联合重建，冻结视频DiT结合参考潜变量并以全序列Flow Matching监督保持身份、背景与运动。结果显示其能在去除水印的同时维持内容与时序一致性。

papers.title: SoftCache: Adaptive Step Size Caching for Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Shimon Malnick, Nadav Orenstein, Ohad Fried, Shai Avidan
papers.abstract: Diffusion and flow models generate a sample over iterative steps, each a full pass through a large network, and that pass dominates generation cost. Training-free caching accelerates them by reusing activations from recent evaluations instead of recomputing them. Dynamic caching methods decide when to refresh by accumulating a cheap probe of the network input into a staleness signal and spending a fresh evaluation once it crosses a threshold. They perform hard caching: the signal is a binary switch between refresh and reuse, and every step, fresh or cached, advances by the prescribed step size. We observe that the signal carries much more than this switch. How far it sits below the threshold, its headroom, predicts the error induced by reuse. We propose SoftCache, which performs soft caching: instead of a binary switch, the headroom sets how far each cached step goes. Where the headroom is large, the sampler jumps past several scheduled nodes, and as a refresh nears, its steps shrink back toward the original step. These adaptive jumps may land between the scheduled nodes, taking the sampler off its fixed grid. SoftCache requires no training and adds no per-backbone settings: on FLUX for images and on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1 for video, at speedups from $3.5\times$ to $6.9\times$, it is ahead of every baseline on all four fidelity metrics.
papers.summary_cn: 扩散与流模型生成需多步完整网络前向传播，计算成本高；现有免训练缓存方法将陈旧度信号仅用作刷新或复用的二元开关，浪费信息。SoftCache 观察到信号距阈值的余量可预测复用误差，据此让缓存步长随余量自适应缩放：余量大时跨越多个调度节点大步跳跃，临近刷新时步长回落至原值，且可偏离固定采样网格。该方法无需训练、无需逐骨干调参，在 FLUX 等模型上以更少的函数评估获得与硬缓存相当或更优的生成质量，实现稳定加速。

papers.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
papers.authors: Chenyuan Zhou, Yining Hong, Huang Huang, Yunfan Jiang, Wenlong Huang, David Held, Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini, Yue Wang, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Leonidas Guibas, Yejin Choi
papers.abstract: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world prediction. At test time, the world model remains frozen and a newly initialized environment latent is optimized from one or more test-time interactions, adapting the model to previously unseen environmental configurations. Across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks, T2-Z reduces object prediction error metric from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%. Its emergent latents capture structured representations of individual and compounded factors across diverse visual scenes. Ablations further show that T2-Z can efficiently infer environment latents from as little as a single test-time interaction trajectory.
papers.summary_cn: 针对机器人预测动作后果时难以顾及摩擦、质量及人为环境规则等不可观测因素，提出测试时优化环境潜变量的T2-Z：训练交替进行固定潜变量学习跨环境动作条件动力学、冻结世界模型仅优化条件潜变量；测试时保持模型冻结，用一次或多次交互从新初始化潜变量适配未见配置。在7个模拟设置中验证，显示紧凑潜变量无需环境因素监督即可捕捉环境变化并改善世界预测。

papers.title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Zirui Wu, Chen Guo, Tianjian Jiang, Zeren Jiang, Zeming Li, Lingchen Yang, Longteng Duan, Ying Xue, Handi Yin, Shenyuan Gao, Martin R. Oswald, Jun Zhang, Ping Tan, Jie Song
papers.abstract: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/
papers.summary_cn: 面向第一视角灵巧操作，构建统一世界动作模型，把从视频重建手部与相机三维运动、按给定动作预测视觉未来、依据初始图像/语言/可选目标联合规划动作及其视觉后果整合到预训练视频扩散变换器；采用共享基座、模态适配与双向视觉-动作注意，并随机隐藏模态使其互为条件或预测目标。实验显示统一训练同时提升感知、预测、规划三项能力，规划质量在视觉语言模型评估中优于专门基线。

papers.title: Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
papers.authors: Weijian Luo, Yujian Chen, Hao Jiang, Guang Cheng, Tianyang Hu
papers.abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) offer an alternative approach to parallel language generation; however, most existing studies directly use transformer architectures from either causal large language models (LLMs) or Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for image generation, which were not optimized for CDLMs. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on Transformer architectures for CDLMs and introduce Language Diffusion Transformer (LangDiT), combining feature and query-key normalization, wider noise conditioning, likelihood-shortcut gradient routing and calibration, and confidence-gated training self-conditioning. LangDiT significantly reduces generation perplexity in matched LangFlow comparisons, establishing a new state of the art in continuous language generation across different model formulations. Using LangFlow as a representative CDLM, LangDiT as a plug-and-play backbone leads to a new state-of-the-art model with a generation perplexity (GenPPL) of 21.72 using 1024 NFEs and 44.72 GenPPL using 128 NFEs on the unconditional generation of 1024-token sequences on the OpenWebText dataset. When adapted to Plaid-style CDLM formulations, LangDiT results in a new leading GenPPL of 11.33 using 1024 denoising NFEs, and 27.51 GenPPL using 128 denoising NFEs. These gains are achieved while retaining each model's underlying representation, training objective, and inference sampler, isolating transformer architecture as a fundamental source of improvement. Our study identifies architectural design as an important source of improvement in continuous diffusion language models.
papers.summary_cn: 面向连续扩散语言模型架构未专门优化的问题，系统改造Transformer并提出LangDiT：结合特征与查询-键归一化、更宽噪声条件、似然捷径梯度路由与校准、置信门控训练自条件。作即插骨干在OpenWebText生成1024词序列时，1024 NFE达GenPPL 21.72，128 NFE为44.72，并在Plaid式设定刷新连续语言生成最优。

papers.title: What Should Robot Policies Learn to Predict? Rethinking Supervision Targets in Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.authors: Haitao Shen, Hanyu Liu, Yihan Lin, Huiping Liu, Junbo Cui, Daoheng Li, Yang Li, Jing Zhang, Wenxin Li, Yuan Yao
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are typically trained with action prediction as the primary supervision signal, since robots ultimately execute actions. Auxiliary objectives such as latent-action (LA) and future-vision (FV) prediction are often added to improve policy learning, yet they compete with action prediction for the same training budget. We ask whether, under a fixed budget, allocating a substantial share of training samples to such objectives, rather than to further action prediction, can improve policy learning. We build a unified VLA framework that couples a two-stream multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT) with a sample-level router, which assigns each training sample to either action prediction or an auxiliary objective and thus makes supervision allocation explicit. Within this framework, we instantiate three LA targets based on LAPA and its DINO-feature variants, and three FV targets based on DINOv3, V-JEPA 2, and Wan2.2 representations. Across LIBERO, CALVIN, and four real-robot tasks, suitable LA and FV supervision outperforms action-only training under the same budget, even when action prediction receives no more than half of the training samples. FV generally outperforms LA, although the strongest LA target remains competitive on CALVIN. Diagnostic analyses suggest that DINO-based LA targets emphasize relative motion, whereas FV targets emphasize absolute position and task identity. We therefore argue that what robot policies learn to predict, and how training is allocated among these targets, should be treated as explicit design choices rather than defaulting to action-dominant training.
papers.summary_cn: 视觉-语言-动作策略通常以动作预测为主要监督信号，辅助目标与动作预测竞争训练预算。作者提出统一框架，将双流多模态扩散Transformer与样本级路由器结合，显式分配每个训练样本用于动作预测或辅助目标，并实例化三种潜在动作与三种未来视觉监督目标。在LIBERO、CALVIN及四个真实机器人任务上，即使动作预测只占不超过一半训练样本，合适的辅助监督仍优于纯动作训练。

papers.title: Trajectory-based Diffusion from One-shot Human Video for Generalizable Manipulation
papers.authors: Guoping Pan, Xinmiao Yu, Wannan Cao, Jincheng Li, Baolin Jiang, Yizhe Li, Yi Cheng, Houde Liu
papers.abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to perform complex tasks by leveraging human-collected demonstrations. However, most existing approaches require labor-intensive data collection with additional teleoperation systems, which hinders scalability. Human videos represent a natural source of data that implicitly contain knowledge of manipulation behaviors. However, transferring them to robots remains challenging due to the visual domain gap and the absence of explicit action labels. In this work, we introduce TDV, a trajectory-based framework that leverages data generation to enable generalizable manipulation. TDV focuses on task-relevant objects by leveraging plug-and-play 6D pose estimation techniques to extract object trajectories from human videos, thereby mitigating the impact of irrelevant backgrounds and varying viewpoints. As a modality-agnostic intermediate representation, trajectories are inherently independent of the visual domains and different embodiments, enabling efficient data generation. Our method outperforms previous approaches on RLBench simulation tasks, achieving near 100\% success rates across seven tasks. In real-world experiments, TDV enables cross-embodiment generalization manipulation from one-shot human demonstrations by leveraging efficient trajectory generation techniques.
papers.summary_cn: 针对模仿学习依赖大量遥操作示教数据、难以扩展的问题，提出基于轨迹的扩散框架TDV，将人类视频作为数据来源。核心思路是利用即插即用的6D位姿估计，从单段人类视频中提取任务相关物体的运动轨迹，将其作为与视觉域和机器人形态无关的中间表征，消除背景与视角差异及缺乏动作标签的影响，并基于轨迹高效生成训练数据。在RLBench仿真七个任务上成功率接近100%，超越以往方法，并在真实实验中实现跨形态泛化操作。

papers.title: Training-Free Target-Aware Refinement of 3D Gaussian Language Map
papers.authors: Sibaek Lee, Kyeongsu Kang, Seongbo Ha, Yewon Jeon, Joonyeol Choi, Daegeol Ko, Jaehyuk Hur, Taemin Choi, Minsu Kim, Hyungjoo Ahn, Wonsok Yoo, Hyeonwoo Yu
papers.abstract: Distilling vision-language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting yields a language map that can be queried with arbitrary text. In deployment, however, a small set of user-specified targets must be reliably located, which current distilled maps often miss, while open-vocabulary queryability for other words must remain intact. We propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Guided by a text-promptable segmenter, the visual embedding inside each detected target region is blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient sets the amount of injected prior, while non-target regions are left untouched. Injecting too much overwrites appearance cues and general queryability, so we seek, for each target, the smallest coefficient that still lets it win, and we obtain every coefficient in closed form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. We further identify a failure mode of injection in language-goal localization. Text embeddings share a common component, and injecting them makes the standard cosine read-out query-agnostic, which a centering step in the read-out removes. Across three benchmarks, the refinement consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation, roughly doubling the base mIoU on Replica, and localizes language goals more reliably than the base map. It also transfers as a plug-in to off-the-shelf field-based and object-level language maps and supports a real-world demonstration in which a legged robot navigates to natural-language goals. Project page and code: https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/
papers.summary_cn: 针对已蒸馏三维高斯语言地图在部署中常漏检用户指定目标、又不能破坏开放词汇查询的问题，提出免训练的目标感知细化：由可文本提示分割器定位目标区域，将其视觉嵌入与目标文本嵌入凸组合融合，非目标区域不动，并对每个目标闭式求解最小注入系数以保留外观线索。另揭示文本嵌入共有分量会使余弦读出与查询无关，用中心化消除；三个基准上持续提升目标定位。

papers.title: FocusOPD: Structure-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Xinrui Lin, Shumin Wang, Suqi Song, Fan Li, Yanyong Zhang
papers.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation enables rectified-flow models with diffusion-transformer architectures to combine task-specific capabilities within a single student. However, matching model outputs does not guarantee that their internal representations are aligned, and it remains unclear where and when additional feature supervision is most useful. We analyze the teacher-student feature mismatch across Transformer blocks and denoising timesteps, and find that the mismatch is concentrated in deeper Transformer blocks during early denoising and persists after OPD distillation, indicating ineffective distillation. Motivated by this observation, we introduce FocusOPD, which augments the base OPD objective with token-wise directional feature alignment restricted to deep layers and early denoising steps. Across two rectified-flow backbones and multiple OPD objectives, FocusOPD improves capability transfer in compositional generation, text rendering, and preference-based evaluation. On the primary benchmark, it improves over DiffusionOPD from 0.953 to 0.967 on GenEval, from 23.797 to 23.944 on PickScore, and from 6.052 to 6.199 on LAION-Aesthetic. Ablations show that selective deep and early supervision is more effective and efficient than alignment over the full network and trajectory.
papers.summary_cn: 针对多教师在线蒸馏中教师与学生内部表征不对齐、蒸馏低效的问题，作者分析了Transformer各层与各去噪时刻的特征失配，发现失配集中于深层模块及早期去噪阶段。据此提出FocusOPD，在基础蒸馏目标上增加限于深层与早期时刻的逐token方向性特征对齐。在两种rectified-flow骨干及多种蒸馏目标上均提升组合生成、文字渲染与偏好评测能力，GenEval从0.953升至0.967，PickScore从23.797升至23.944，LAION美学分从6.052升至6.199。

papers.title: UltraDiff: Transferring High-Fidelity Priors to Compressed Latent Spaces for High-Resolution Image Generation
papers.authors: Jingjing Ren, Haitian Zheng, Haoyu Chen, Connelly Barnes, Zhifei Zhang, Yuqian Zhou, Zhe Lin, Lei Zhu
papers.abstract: High-resolution synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) faces a fundamental trade-off between computational cost and generative fidelity. This trade off is largely governed by the latent compression factor f (e.g. f8 denotes f=8 and f32 f=32). While aggressive compression (f32) significantly improves efficiency, it suffers from severe information loss and ambiguity compared to standard f8 models. We propose UltraDiff, a framework that reformulates this challenge as joint latent diffusion learning followed by marginal score distillation. We introduce MixTeacher, a dual branch DiT that models the joint f8-f32 distribution, utilizing shared attention to resolve the ambiguity of the compressed space with high fidelity f8 priors. Crucially, we propose vector field distillation in the native f32 space. Theoretically, this compels the student to learn the conditional expectation of the teacher trajectory, effectively filtering out compression artifacts. Across the evaluated 1K to 4K settings, UltraDiff approaches f8 level quality while preserving f32 efficiency. With 20 sampling steps on a single A100 GPU, it generates a 2K image in 6.2 seconds over 40 times faster than our f8 baseline.
papers.summary_cn: 针对潜空间扩散模型在高分辨率生成中计算成本与保真度难以兼得的问题，提出UltraDiff框架：先联合学习f8与f32潜空间分布，再在原生f32空间进行边缘分数蒸馏。核心是双分支DiT结构MixTeacher，通过共享注意力将高保真f8先验迁移到高压缩f32空间；向量场蒸馏使学生模型学习教师轨迹的条件期望，从而滤除压缩伪影。在1K至4K生成任务中，质量接近f8水平并保留f32效率；单张A100上20步采样生成2K图像仅需6.2秒，比f8基线快40倍以上。

papers.title: Sparse Attention for Video Generation Acceleration via Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search
papers.authors: Yun Dai, Yuyun Chen, Jiarui Wen, Huiping Zhuang, Cen Chen, Ziqian Zeng
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) dominate video generation but suffer from high inference cost due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Sparse attention mitigates this by skipping unnecessary computation in the attention matrix, but existing methods apply a fixed sparsity ratio throughout denoising and struggle to accurately determine which computations to skip. To address these limitations, we analyze attention dynamics through attention entropy and mean attention distance, and find that attention becomes increasingly concentrated across denoising steps. We further observe that blocks selected early continue to capture a large fraction of the total attention weight at later steps. These findings suggest two acceleration opportunities: the sparsity ratio should grow as denoising progresses, and earlier search results can be reused to reduce the search space. Based on these findings, we propose Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search (GSRS), a training-free framework that retains more computation early and progressively reduces it later, while restricting subsequent searches to an early candidate set to reduce search overhead. GSRS adopts Top-p selection for adaptive sparsity control, supported by a precise evaluation scheme that computes exact attention weights within the FlashAttention computation at negligible overhead. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1 validate that GSRS achieves 1.55$\times$--2.21$\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality comparable to full attention.
papers.summary_cn: 扩散Transformer视频生成因自注意力二次复杂度导致推理成本高，现有稀疏注意力在整个去噪过程使用固定稀疏率且难以准确判断可跳过的计算。通过分析注意力熵与平均注意力距离，发现注意力随去噪步骤逐渐集中，且早期选出的块在后期仍占较大注意力权重。据此提出免训练的GSRS框架：稀疏率随去噪进程逐步增大，并将后续搜索限制在早期候选集内以降低搜索开销，采用Top-p选择实现自适应稀疏，从而加速视频生成。

papers.title: RoPE-Flow: Monocular Vision-based Robot Pose Estimation via 2D Graph-Conditioned 3D Flow Matching
papers.authors: Liangjing Shao, Wanhao Liu, Zhiwei Fang, Rulin Zhou, Quanlu Zhang, Changjing Liu, Beilei Cui, Yiming Huang, Hongliang Ren
papers.abstract: Camera-to-robot pose estimation from a monocular image is significant for vision-based robot navigation and control. However, recovering 3D structural features from 2D observations remains a challenging task. Existing camera-to-robot pose estimation methods either rely on time-consuming iterative rendering or involve sophisticated 2D-3D registration which suffers from projection ambiguity, accumulated errors for distal joints and imbalanced learning for different joints. In this work, we propose RoPE-Flow, an end-to-end flow matching-based framework for camera-to-robot pose estimation. From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: ropeflow.netlify.app
papers.summary_cn: 针对单目图像估计相机到机器人位姿时，二维观测难恢复三维结构、迭代渲染耗时且配准受投影歧义与远端误差累积影响的问题，RoPE-Flow 用流匹配端到端回归：由二维热图提取关键点中心多尺度特征，以可学习邻接图生成条件，并用骨长损失、射线深度损失和关节加权保持拓扑与尺度。实验优于现有最优方法，增强远端关节与整体稳定性。

papers.title: MIDI-REPA: Improving Text-to-Music Generation with Symbolic Representation Alignment
papers.authors: Song-Ze Yu, Fang-Duo Tsai, Yi-Hsuan Yang
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art text-to-music models increasingly rely on scaling model capacity, data, and compute, while still learning musical structure directly from dense audio. Yet melody, rhythm, harmony, and structure can be represented compactly in symbolic form. We introduce MIDI-REPA, a representation-alignment framework that derives MIDI supervision from automatic music transcription (AMT) to align intermediate representations of a flow-matching DiT. Building on the 122M-parameter FluxAudio-S baseline from the 2026 ICME Academic Text-To-Music Challenge, we investigate what, where, and when to align. Aligning a MuScriptor-derived piano roll with an early DiT layer throughout the full flow trajectory performs the best. Without additional training data or techniques, MIDI-REPA remains competitive on the ATTM objective metrics while remaining trainable on a single RTX 3090 in about 31 hours. Our results highlight symbolic supervision as a simple and inexpensive learning signal for improving text-to-music generation. We release our transcription pipeline, JamendoMIDI, training code, and audio samples at https://midi-repa.vaclis.net.
papers.summary_cn: 现有文本生成音乐模型依赖扩大规模并直接从密集音频学习结构，效率低下。为此提出MIDI-REPA表示对齐框架，利用自动音乐转录获得MIDI监督信号，对齐流匹配DiT的中间层表示。基于122M参数的FluxAudio-S基线，系统研究了对齐内容、位置与时机，发现将由MuScriptor得到的钢琴卷帘与早期DiT层在完整流轨迹上对齐效果最佳。该方法无需额外数据即在ATTM客观指标上保持竞争力，且可在单张RTX 3090上约31小时完成训练，同时开源了转录流水线JamendoMIDI与代码。

papers.title: Representation Conditioning for Generation
papers.authors: Saeed Razavi, Xingjian Leng, Liang Zheng
papers.abstract: Representation-alignment methods effectively accelerate the diffusion transformer training. REPA, for example, uses a pretrained vision encoder to supervise an intermediate layer through an MLP projection head which is discarded after training. It aims to import semantics from the vision encoder to the diffusion backbone. While this objective is achieved at early layers by back-propagating the alignment loss, there is no guarantee that later layers, supervised by the velocity prediction loss alone, can well access such semantics. We propose a simple solution, representation conditioning (RECON), to improve semantics in later layers. During training, we feed the pretrained vision encoder tokens into later layers; during inference, because we no longer have the clean image, we reuse the MLP head (as a proxy to the vision encoder) and project its output tokens to the later layers. Our method adds no parameters and leads to much faster convergence: RECON is $63\times$ faster than SiT and $25\times$ faster than REPA. Code is available at https://github.com/saeidrazavi/RECON
papers.summary_cn: 针对扩散Transformer中REPA仅能保证浅层获得视觉语义、后续层缺乏语义监督的问题，提出表示条件化方法RECON：训练时直接将预训练视觉编码器的token注入网络深层，推理时复用训练后保留的MLP投影头作为编码器代理，将其输出投影至深层。该方法不增加任何参数，显著加速收敛，比SiT快63倍，比REPA快25倍。

papers.title: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
papers.authors: Huixuan Cheng, Bike Zhang, Shankar Sastry, Koushil Sreenath
papers.abstract: Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. Trained on networks collected from reinforcement learning for the Unitree G1 robot, our approach generates deployable networks that perform various motions in the real world, including walking, dancing, and spin kick. Beyond generation, we further study the learned weight space to better understand the structure captured by these humanoid control networks. We identify a structural principle in the first-layer weights that consistently reflects the robot's kinematic prior. Notably, this kinematic prior emerges under both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) training, suggesting that it is not specific to a particular optimization process but may instead reflect common knowledge associated with humanoid embodiment. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of generative modeling in humanoid network weight space, while providing initial insights into the information encoded by their learned weights. Additional results are available on our project website: https://humanoid-weight-diffusion.github.io/
papers.summary_cn: 针对人形机器人控制网络只能通过常规训练获得、其权重分布缺乏直接建模的问题，提出用扩散模型在权重空间生成功能性控制网络。方法采用线性自编码器将演员网络参数压缩到紧凑潜空间，再用扩散Transformer建模该潜空间分布。在宇树G1机器人上基于强化学习收集的网络训练后，生成的网络可直接部署，真实完成行走、跳舞、回旋踢等多种动作，并揭示了控制网络权重空间中捕获的结构规律。

papers.title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
papers.authors: Xiaoli Xu, Zhengtao Wu, Zhengze Xu, Tao Liu, Yongchao Du, Zuan Gao, Xingjian Wang, Hao Yan, Mengting Chen, Wei Li, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. It also matches much larger closed-source models, and beats several of them at Instruction Following and Product Integration - the two properties that determine whether an image can be published.
papers.summary_cn: 面向电商SKU主图的商业级自动生成，框架串联信息抽取、语义改写与多条件生成：PERL-Agent用VLM/LLM闭环迭代和无参考评分提炼卖点，LTO交替优化对齐文案与渲染质量，SKU-DiT经RDR渐进训练联合约束白底图、商标裁剪与结构化布局，兼顾主体保真、商标完整与字符级文本准确；已支撑每日数百万张、单图数秒的生产规模，并发布难例基准CommerceGen-Bench。

papers.title: RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation
papers.authors: Siming Fu, Zheming Fu, Lianrui Mu, Haoyang Huang, Chaojie Gu, Ruizhe He
papers.abstract: Distilling pretrained video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) generators typically combines student initialization with distribution matching distillation (DMD). An intermediate AR teacher can provide causally compatible targets for ODE initialization. However, causally compatible targets alone do not ensure high-quality generation under a short sampling schedule. We analyze the posterior-mean predictions favored by direct latent regression and empirically find that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but still leaves fine detail unresolved. To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing, which learns few-step causal initialization through representation-space supervision rather than intermediate-teacher trajectory regression. The student is trained with teacher forcing by comparing clean predictions and training targets through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. This phase reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional model for AR teacher training and replaces both teacher training and causal ODE distillation, without generating additional causal ODE trajectories. The subsequent asymmetric DMD procedure remains unchanged. Empirical results show that, at four sampling steps, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization before DMD. After DMD, our four-step chunk-wise model improves VBench Total from 84.04 to 84.66 (+0.62 points) and VisionReward from 6.326 to 10.074 (+59.25%) over the reported causal-ODE-based baseline.
papers.summary_cn: 针对把视频扩散模型蒸馏成少步自回归生成器时，短采样下虽经因果常微分初始化仍细节不足的问题，提出表示强制：用冻结视频扩散变换器的归一化特征做教师强制监督，替代中间教师训练与因果轨迹回归，并复用双向模型合成视频；随后接不对称分布匹配蒸馏。结果显示可省去额外因果常微分轨迹，缓解模糊并更好保留细节。

papers.title: ForceBench: Benchmarking Force Integration for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Xuan Han, Zinuo Jin, Tianlin Li, Yunfan Lou, Xin Liu, Yuchen Xue, Yuanpeng He, Boxian Yao, Shuhan Zhan, Ruihai Wu, Zhibo Pang
papers.abstract: Force feedback provides vision-language-action (VLA) policies with physical observations that can guide action selection and execution. However, differences in tasks, demonstrations, and control settings across existing systems hinder reliable comparisons of force integration designs. We introduce ForceBench, a simulation benchmark for evaluating six-axis wrist-force integration under a unified protocol. ForceBench combines eight tasks spanning physical-property inference, resistance-dependent interaction, and contact-rich assembly with 1,600 synchronized demonstrations and task-specific success criteria. We compare one no-force baseline and six force integration designs on a shared $π_{0.5}$ backbone. Prompt Fusion achieves the highest observed mean simulation success of 35.31%, compared with 23.25% for the baseline, and improves success rates across all three task categories. Predictive and temporal gains in simulation concentrate on physical-property inference, while both temporal designs underperform the baseline on assembly. Real-world evaluation of eight systems across five tasks supports the main qualitative trends: Prompt Fusion and Dual-Path Fusion achieve 63.00% mean success, compared with 40.00% for the baseline, but only Prompt Fusion improves every task. These findings support ForceBench's practical value for identifying the benefits and limitations of force integration across manipulation demands. The project page is available at https://forcebench-platform.github.io/.
papers.summary_cn: 针对力反馈融入视觉-语言-动作策略缺乏统一比较标准的问题，构建仿真基准ForceBench，包含八类任务与1600条同步演示，统一评估六维腕力集成。基于共享π0.5骨干比较无力基线与六种融合方案，Prompt Fusion仿真平均成功率35.31%，高于基线23.25%且三类任务均提升；真机验证趋势一致，Prompt Fusion与Dual-Path Fusion平均成功率63.00%。

papers.title: DeBoneDiT: Depth-Driven Conditional Bridge Diffusion Transformers for Bone Suppression in Chest X-Ray Images
papers.authors: Yifei Sun, Fenglei Fan, Junhao Jia, Wenming Deng, Hongxia Xu, Changmiao Wang, Ruiquan Ge
papers.abstract: Chest X-Ray (CXR) is a primary modality for diagnosing pulmonary diseases, yet the overlap of bony structures often obscures critical radiographic findings, increasing the risk of diagnostic uncertainty. While Dual-Energy Subtraction (DES) is the clinical benchmark for bone suppression, its widespread adoption is primarily hindered by specialized hardware requirements and increased radiation exposure. Recently, diffusion-based generative models have shown promise for this task, yet they are still constrained by reconstruction-biased latent compression, prior-induced domain gap, and a scarcity of high-quality paired datasets. To address these challenges, we propose DeBoneDiT, a depth-driven conditional bridge diffusion Transformer architecture for efficient high-resolution bone suppression. We first introduce Depth Auto-Encoder (DAE), a structure-aware vision tokenizer for latent compression. By incorporating a multi-level depth feature loss derived from the pretrained Depth Anything V2 encoder, DAE preserves both visual fidelity and structural consistency. Second, we formulate bone suppression as a source-conditioned Brownian bridge diffusion process, leveraging CXRs as both the diffusion prior and structural guidance to narrow the source-to-target domain gap and maintain anatomical plausibility. Furthermore, we have constructed and released SZCH-X-Rays, the largest publicly available high-quality paired dataset for bone suppression to date, comprising 741 pairs of CXR and DES soft tissue images. Extensive experiments and downstream evaluation demonstrate that DeBoneDiT achieves superior bone suppression performance with reduced computational overhead.
papers.summary_cn: 针对胸部X光骨性结构重叠遮挡病灶、双能减影依赖专用硬件且增加辐射、扩散模型受压缩偏置与配对数据不足制约的问题，提出DeBoneDiT：用Depth Anything V2多级深度特征损失训练结构感知DAE潜码，再以CXR为条件构建布朗桥扩散完成高分辨率骨抑制。给定摘要截断，未报告PSNR、SSIM等定量结果。

papers.title: Long-horizon Video Generation with Slot Memory Addressed By Region Tokens
papers.authors: Eren Cetin, Julius Erbach, Vukasin Bozic, Hyojun Go, Zixiang Zhao, Nikolai Kalischek, Federico Tombari, Konrad Schindler, Dominik Narnhofer
papers.abstract: Memory for long-horizon video generation must satisfy two competing requirements: it must remain bounded so generation can continue indefinitely, while still recovering what was observed at a place when the camera returns, regardless of how long ago it was seen. Reconstruction-based memories provide spatial recall by caching and reprojecting explicit geometry, but require growing storage and depend on estimated 3D structure. Recurrent memories keep a constant-size state, but retention is governed by temporal recurrence, causing old observations to fade with time. We introduce SMART, a slot memory addressed by region tokens, which combines bounded storage with spatially addressed recall. SMART stores content in a constant-size slot recurrence whose writes are addressed by the observing camera and whose reads are queried by the rendering camera, without constructing an explicit 3D representation or maintaining a growing cache. Consequently, recall is conditioned on inter-view geometry rather than on recency. Each read additionally provides a confidence estimate that conditions a chunk-causal diffusion transformer, allowing it to selectively trust retrieved content while relying on its generative prior elsewhere. On long trajectories in Memory Maze and Minecraft, SMART maintains high-fidelity recall far beyond its training horizon while using constant memory and per-step cost.
papers.summary_cn: 长时序视频生成的记忆机制面临存储有界与空间召回难以兼顾的问题：基于重建的记忆需不断增长的存储，循环记忆则随时间遗忘旧观测。为此提出 SMART，一种由区域令牌寻址的槽位记忆，写入由观测相机寻址、读取由渲染相机查询，无需显式三维表示即保持常数级存储，使召回取决于视角几何而非时间远近。每次读取附带置信度，用于调节块因果扩散 Transformer，使其有选择地信任检索内容，实现可无限延续的长时序生成。

papers.title: Discovering Undisclosed Concepts in LoRA Adapters for Diffusion-Based AIGC Models
papers.authors: Yupeng Qiu, Han Fang, Dhananjai Sharma, Ee-Chien Chang
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has made diffusion model personalization affordable and widely shareable, but it also creates moderation risks when harmful or problematic content is not faithfully disclosed. Hence, it is desired to develop a mechanism that, given a LoRA adapter, discovers the concept it was trained to generate, so as to support downstream investigation. We characterize the target concept through the conditioning input that most clearly exposes what the LoRA has learned. Such an input should induce coherent LoRA outputs that are distinctive from those of the base model and strongly align with the learned LoRA subspace. We therefore formulate concept discovery as searching for the conditioning input that jointly maximizes output coherence, LoRA-induced distinctiveness, and subspace alignment. Even with a clear objective, however, optimizing it over an open-ended input space is prohibitively expensive, since reliable evaluation of coherence and distinctiveness requires repeated diffusion rendering. Crucially, we observe that an input need not be rendered to determine whether it is promising. Its alignment with the learned LoRA subspace provides a lightweight signal for localizing promising candidates before visual verification. Based on this insight, we develop a two-stage framework for text-to-image LoRAs. Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES) uses render-free subspace alignment to explore candidate prompts and retain a compact shortlist, while Paired Visual Identification (PVI) renders only these candidates and compares the LoRA and base-model outputs to identify those exhibiting coherent and distinctive generation behavior. This design enables efficient and reliable discovery of previously unknown concepts encoded in LoRA adapters.
papers.summary_cn: 针对扩散模型中 LoRA 适配器可能隐藏有害或未如实披露概念带来的监管风险，提出一种概念发现机制：给定 LoRA 适配器，自动推断其训练时学习的生成概念。方法将问题建模为搜索使输出连贯性、与基座模型的区分度及与 LoRA 子空间对齐度三者联合最大化的条件输入。针对开放输入空间搜索代价高、反复渲染评估昂贵的问题，利用输入与 LoRA 子空间的对齐程度作为轻量代理信号，无需渲染即可筛选有潜力的候选输入，从而高效定位最能揭示所学概念的条件输入，为下游安全审查提供支持。

papers.title: MiniDog: Dog-Breed Text-to-image Flow Matching from Pretraining to Fine-Tuning on 4 Consumer GPUs
papers.authors: Reyhaneh Esmailizadeh, Xingjian Leng, Zhanhao Liang, Liang Zheng
papers.abstract: We generally perceive that training text-to-image diffusion models requires heavy compute: it is true if we aim at a comprehensive frontier model. This understanding prevents people from training their own models when getting started in the field. We develop MiniDog, a framework that enables pretraining diffusion transformers in 55 minutes and fine-tuning in another 15 minutes on four 3090 GPUs. For data, we use 26k dog images from ImageNet and caption them for pretraining and use 2k images generated by FLUX.1-schnell for fine-tuning. We precompute the image and text features and cache them for efficiency. For architecture, we use E2E-INVAE for its semantic latent space, a small transformer with 22M parameters, a small Qwen model for text encoding, and in-context conditioning. For training, we use iREPA and an EUPE perception encoder for acceleration. For evaluation, our repository supports FID, HPSv2 score, PickScore, and various VAE reconstruction metrics. The project is open-sourced at https://github.com/Reyhaneesmailizadeh/MiniDog. We do not claim technical novelty.
papers.summary_cn: 针对个人训练文生图扩散模型成本过高、难以上手的问题，构建面向犬类生成的低成本全流程框架：用ImageNet的2.6万张狗图配文预训练，再用FLUX.1-schnell生成的2千张图微调，并预计算缓存图文特征；架构采用语义潜空间自编码器、2200万参数小Transformer、小型Qwen文本编码与上下文条件，结合iREPA和EUPE感知编码加速。四张3090上预训练55分钟、微调15分钟，支持FID、HPSv2、PickScore及VAE重建指标并开源。

papers.title: EqC: Equilibrium Energy Control for Introspective Lifelong Robot Learning
papers.authors: Haodong Yang, Runhan Huang, Bowen Zhang, Iofai Lei, Zunzhe Zhang, Xiangcheng Zhang, Shaoting Zhu, Linzhan Mou, Yicheng Liu, Hang Zhao
papers.abstract: Long-term robot autonomy depends on more than effective action generation: a policy must recognize when its behavior is no longer sufficiently supported and use assistance to improve. We introduce Equilibrium Energy Control (EqC), a framework for introspective lifelong robot learning built around an explicit conditional energy landscape. EqC casts generative action refinement as equilibrium-seeking optimization, while the geometry of the refinement process reveals whether the generated behavior remains consistent with the learned landscape. This competence signal enables Energy-Gated DAgger, where persistent energy-consistency violations trigger expert takeover and the resulting recovery trajectories are aggregated for subsequent policy updates. EqC integrates naturally into both Diffusion Transformer policies and flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies. Across simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation, EqC matches or improves control performance and robustness while enabling timely intervention near the policy's competence boundary. A real-world study further shows how these interventions progressively expand the range of situations handled autonomously, providing a practical path from static generative controllers toward self-improving robot systems.
papers.summary_cn: 面向长期自主中策略难以自察能力边界、何时求助并借专家示范持续进化的问题，EqC 用显式条件能量景观把生成式动作修正建模为趋于均衡的优化，并以修正几何的一致性作胜任信号；能量—一致性持续违例即触发 Energy-Gated DAgger 接管，汇聚恢复轨迹回流更新，可嵌入 Diffusion Transformer 与流匹配 VLA。仿真与真实双臂操作显示其保持或提升控制与鲁棒性，并在能力边界附近及时干预，真实研究中自主处理情境随干预逐步扩展。

papers.title: UniW(A)M: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for World and World-Action Models
papers.authors: Jingbo Xu, Jianjie Fang, Zhuohang Li, Zihao Song, Zhaolu Wang, Xvyuan Liu, Xin Zhang, Haisheng Su, Yinzhou Tang, Chen Gao, Wei Wu, Yong Li
papers.abstract: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm.   We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen.   We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.
papers.summary_cn: 世界模型与世界-动作模型分别负责未来预测与动作生成，但通常孤立训练，限制了预测与控制间的知识复用。UniW(A)M提出基于扩散Transformer的混合专家统一框架：共享专家学习通用动力学，原子能力专家跨接口复用并保留各自条件路径；部署时通过插件式自适应接口路由器PAIR，仅用少量目标任务数据在冻结骨干下为每个执行块选择合适接口。在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及三个真实操作任务上的实验验证了其在任务成功率与执行效率间的良好平衡。

papers.title: Recasting DiT for Extreme Image Compression with Hierarchical Visual Priors
papers.authors: Yunuo Chen, Jingnan Gao, Bing He, Jinjing Zhao, Chuqin Zhou, Xiaoyue Ling, Li Song, Guo Lu, Wenjun Zhang
papers.abstract: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for extreme image compression, but their stochastic, iterative generation processes are not designed to decode compressed representations directly. We present PrismCodec, which recasts a pretrained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) as a bitstream-grounded one-step generative decoder. PrismCodec uses the decoded representation in two complementary roles: a projected codec state defines the starting state for generation, while hierarchical visual priors derived from the same decoded latent provide semantic and structural guidance. To bridge the gap between stochastic, iterative generation and deterministic one-step decoding, we develop a progressive adaptation strategy. We first learn codec-conditioned transport from a noisy neighborhood centered on the codec state, distill it into a one-step mapping, and finally anneal the source perturbation to zero during end-to-end optimization. The resulting decoder reconstructs deterministically from the received representation without additional conditioning bits. Across Kodak, CLIC, and DIV2K, PrismCodec consistently improves rate-perception performance over prior generative codecs, achieving BD-rate reductions of 70-75% in LPIPS and 75-81% in DISTS over StableCodec. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_cn: 针对预训练扩散模型随机迭代生成过程难以直接解码压缩码流的问题，PrismCodec将预训练Diffusion Transformer改造为以码流为基础的单步生成解码器。其核心思路是让解码表示承担双重角色：投影后的编解码状态作为生成起点，同时从同一隐变量提取层次化视觉先验提供语义与结构引导；并通过渐进式适配策略，先学习以编解码状态为中心噪声邻域的条件传输，再蒸馏为单步映射，最终在端到端优化中将源扰动退火至零。该方法无需额外条件比特即可确定性重建，在Kodak、CLIC和DIV2K数据集上均稳定提升了率-感知性能。

papers.title: EmoGenie: Benchmarking and Evaluating Expressed and Evoked Emotion in T2I Generation with MLLMs
papers.authors: Zixuan Xing, Lancheng Gao, Shengyan Li, Huiyu Duan, Zhaolin Cai, Guangtao Zhai, Xiongkuo Min
papers.abstract: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) have significantly promoted using text-to-image (T2I) models to generate images with specific affective intentions. However, the emotional effects conveyed by generated images frequently deviate from target expectations, and it remains unclear whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reliably interpret the emotion of AI-generated visual content. Existing affective benchmarks are predominantly built on natural images, while affective studies of generated images have largely focused on emotions expressed in portraits, lacking a unified benchmark for studying the emotions expressed and evoked by generated images. We therefore introduce EmoGenie, a benchmark of emotion for AI-generated images that evaluates capabilities in T2I generation and MLLM understanding across expressed and evoked emotions. It comprises 6,400 images generated by eight T2I models using 800 emotion-targeted prompts, annotated with question-answer (QA) pairs, termed EmoGenie-QA, and continuous human ratings, termed EmoGenie-Assess. EmoGenie-QA contains 90,000 closed-set questions in single-image and image-pair settings, as well as 1,057 open-ended questions for emotion description. EmoGenie-Assess benchmarks continuous affective and aesthetic prediction using 13,175 mean opinion scores (MOSs) aggregated from human ratings in terms of valence, arousal, dominance, and aesthetic quality. We further develop EmoProbe, which combines emotion question answering with response-aligned, dimension-specific regression heads for continuous score prediction. Experimental results show that EmoProbe achieves superior results on emotion-related QA tasks, while its affective and aesthetic predictions correlate better with human ratings, demonstrating its state-of-the-art capabilities of unified coarse-to-fine affective understanding for AI-generated images.
papers.summary_cn: 针对生成图像情感常偏离目标、且缺乏统一基准评估表达与唤起情感的问题，构建 EmoGenie：用8个T2I模型按800条情感提示生成6,400张图，配套9万闭集问答和连续人工评分，覆盖单图与图像对设置，系统检验T2I情感生成与MLLM理解能力，显示二者仍不可靠。

papers.title: ShoeFit: A New Dataset and Dual-image-stream DiT Framework for Virtual Footwear Try-On
papers.authors: Yuhan Li, Zhiyu Jin, Yifan Tong, Wenxiang Shang, Benlei Cui, Xuanhong Chen, Hangcheng Zhu, Bingbing Ni
papers.abstract: Virtual footwear try-on (VFTON), a critical yet underexplored area in virtual try-on (VTON), aims to synthesize faithful try-on results given diverse footwear and model images while maintaining 3D consistency and texture authenticity. Unlike conventional garment-focused VTON methods, VFTON presents unique challenges due to (1) Data Scarcity, which arises from the difficulty of perfectly matching product shoes with models wearing the identical ones, (2) Viewpoint Misalignment, where the target foot pose and source shoe views are always misaligned, leading to incomplete texture information and detail distortion, and (3) Background-induced Color Distortion, where complex material of footwear interacts with environmental lighting, causing unintended color contamination. To address these challenges, we introduce MVShoes, a multi-view shoe try-on dataset consisting of 7305 well-annotated image triplets, covering diverse footwear categories and challenging try-on scenarios. Furthermore, we propose a dual-stream DiT architecture, ShoeFit, designed to mitigate viewpoint misalignment through Multi-View Conditioning with 3D Rotary Position Embedding, and alleviate background-induced distortion using the LayeredRefAttention which leverages background features to modulate footwear latents. The proposed framework effectively decouples shoe appearance from environmental interferences while preserving high-quality texture detail through decoupled denoising and conditioning branches. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method substantially improves rendering fidelity and robustness under challenging real-world product shoes, establishing a new benchmark in high-fidelity footwear try-on synthesis.
papers.summary_cn: 虚拟鞋类试穿存在数据稀缺、视角不对齐和背景致色失真三大难题。为此构建了包含7305组精细标注图像三元组的多视角鞋类试穿数据集MVShoes，并提出双流DiT架构ShoeFit，通过结合三维旋转位置编码的多视角条件机制缓解视角错位，抑制背景颜色干扰。实验表明该方法在保持三维一致性与纹理真实性方面优于现有方法，实现了更逼真的鞋类试穿效果。

papers.title: Omni-RS: Unifying Multi-Task Understanding and Generation in Remote Sensing
papers.authors: Pan Yin, Shuai Yang, Yuanhao Liu, Datao Tang, Jialin Li, Hao Wang, Pei Liu, Kaiyu Li, Cong Zhao, Xiangyong Cao
papers.abstract: Practical remote sensing applications often require both understanding and generation capabilities for the same geographic scene. However, most existing methods address either understanding or generation in isolation, while existing unified remote sensing models' generative ability is limited to text-to-image. To bridge this gap, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework supporting four remote sensing understanding tasks and five generation tasks. Specifically, we introduce the "Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training" strategy, which first adapts a multimodal large language model to remote sensing understanding and then uses its hidden states to guide a diffusion transformer for image generation. To enable joint learning across diverse generation tasks, we construct UniGen, a unified multi-task generation dataset, by organizing heterogeneous remote sensing data into a unified format. Furthermore, we introduce "Detailed Visual Conditioning", which uses visual conditions encoded by a VAE to guide the generation process, thereby supporting additional generation tasks that require reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-RS performs exceptionally well in understanding tasks and has achieved outstanding results in a variety of generative tasks.
papers.summary_cn: 遥感实际应用常需对同一场景同时具备理解与生成能力，但现有方法多将二者割裂，统一模型的生成能力也仅限于文生图。为此提出统一框架 Omni-RS，支持4类遥感理解任务和5类生成任务。其核心是场景引导的两阶段训练策略：先让多模态大语言模型适配遥感理解，再利用其隐状态引导扩散 Transformer 生成图像；同时构建统一格式的多任务生成数据集 UniGen，并引入基于 VAE 编码视觉条件的细节视觉条件机制以支持需要参考图的生成任务。大量实验表明该框架在理解任务上表现优异。

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Affordance Transfer for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Sawera Yaseen, Serge Thill, Rekha Raja
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation systems commonly learn object affordances from human-annotated datasets, which reflect interaction possibilities for a human hand rather than the physical constraints of a specific robot. For example, a surface region of an object identified as graspable by a human annotator may be geometrically unreachable or mechanically infeasible for a robot, yet this mismatch is rarely addressed explicitly. To tackle this challenge, we proposed a framework that translates human affordance annotations into robot-executable affordance predictions conditioned on the physical properties of the robot. The network predicts which surface regions of an object are physically executable by the robot, given a 3D point cloud of an object and a descriptor encoding the robot's geometry and constraints. The model was trained using human-annotated affordances together with robotic execution outcomes from multiple sampled approach trials in simulation, where execution outcomes determined which regions are executable for the robot. The evaluation was performed on a household objects dataset using two parallel-jaw gripper configurations on a UR5e robot arm. The framework outperformed a model that does not receive information about the robot. The experimental results demonstrated that affordance prediction must be conditioned on the robot and that human annotations alone are insufficient for learning robot-executable affordance representations.
papers.summary_cn: 针对人类标注的可供性往往不符合机器人实际物理约束（如人手可达区域对机器人却不可抓）的问题，提出跨本体可供性迁移框架：以物体三维点云和编码机器人几何与约束的描述符为输入，预测机器人实际可执行的表面区域。模型结合人类标注与仿真中多次采样接近试验的执行结果进行训练，在UR5e机械臂配两种平行夹爪的家用物品数据集上评估，性能优于未考虑机器人约束的基线模型。

papers.title: LinMorph: Learning to Morph Weights for Efficient Video DiT Linearization
papers.authors: Lingyi Long, Congyue Zhao, Xiaoou Li, Yanmin Qian, Tao Huang
papers.abstract: Post-hoc linearization is an attractive way to accelerate pretrained Video Diffusion Transformers (Video DiTs), yet existing methods largely treat the quality loss induced by attention replacement as a recovery problem. We show that a more fundamental bottleneck lies upstream: \emph{initialization}. Random initialization discards pretrained knowledge, whereas manual weight reuse transfers it through rigid and incomplete source--target correspondences. We introduce \textbf{LinMorph}, which recasts Video DiT linearization as a learnable softmax-to-linear weight transformation problem. Instead of copying predefined counterparts, LinMorph learns a cross-parameter morphism that lets each target Gated DeltaNet (GDN) parameter draw jointly from pretrained query, key, value, and output projections, including for parameters with no direct softmax counterpart. A single morphism is shared across layers and learned through local teacher alignment, while producing layer-specific initializations from their respective pretrained weights. The resulting weights are then materialized as independent GDN modules for progressive distillation and joint recovery.Since the morphism operates in weight space rather than token space, it can be learned on short, low-resolution clips and directly reused at larger video scales. Across pretrained Video DiTs, LinMorph enables markedly faster recovery and better final generation quality than random initialization and heuristic weight reuse. Results show that efficient linearization depends not only on how a converted model is recovered, but critically on how pretrained knowledge is transferred before recovery. Project page: https://lonelyling.github.io/LinMorph.
papers.summary_cn: 针对视频扩散Transformer后验线性化中注意力替换导致质量下降的问题，指出根本瓶颈在于初始化：随机初始化丢弃预训练知识，手动复用则对应关系僵化。提出LinMorph，将线性化重述为可学习的softmax到线性权重变换，让每个目标GDN参数共同从预训练的查询、键、值和输出投影中汲取知识，包括无直接对应的部分。单一态射跨层共享，通过局部教师对齐学习，生成各层专属初始化，再实体化为独立模块进行渐进蒸馏与联合恢复，有效保留预训练知识。

papers.title: LoopREG: Representation Supervision Enables Test-Time Recurrent Depth in Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Zipeng Wang, Anping Xiong, Jing Zhang, Xiaoya Zhu, Yi Jiang, Yanbing Xiao, Zige Zeng, Zezhou Chen, Xiang Liu, Huan Hu, Ping Chen, Kai Wang, Zhaoxiang Liu, Shiguo Lian, Ye LV, Fang Zhao, Huanlin Gao, Zhengrui Huang, Bo Shen, Yuren You
