papers.abstract: Reusing Transformer blocks offers a way to increase diffusion-model computation at test time, but naive recurrence can degrade generation beyond its training depth. We introduce LoopREG, a representation-supervised recurrent diffusion Transformer that repeatedly applies a shared block at the state supervised by a pretrained visual encoder. Alignment is applied after the final recurrent visit during training; inference extends the same learned operator to additional visits. On ImageNet 256 x 256, LoopREG reduces SiT-B/2 FID from the local REG baseline's 15.08 to 4.91 at 400K training steps, a 67.41% reduction. Within a checkpoint trained with two visits, one extra inference visit improves FID from 14.71 to 5.34 with unchanged weights. The benefit persists on SiT-L/2 and SiT-XL/2. Controlled interventions show that useful recurrence follows the location of representation supervision, while REPA alignment produces a smaller extrapolation benefit. These results make representation-supervised recurrence a practical route to improving diffusion generation through additional inference depth.
papers.summary_cn: 针对测试时复用扩散 Transformer 块虽能增加计算、朴素循环却在超出训练深度后退化的问题，LoopREG 在预训练视觉编码器监督的状态上反复应用共享块，训练只对末次循环访问做表征对齐，推理再外推更多访问。ImageNet 256×256 上，SiT-B/2 经 400K 步 FID 由 15.08 降至 4.91，减少 67.41%；两次访问训练的权重不变，多加一次推理访问使 FID 由 14.71 降至 5.34，并在 SiT-L/2、SiT-XL/2 上保持收益。

papers.title: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
papers.authors: Tiancheng Shen, Zilong Huang, Xiangtai Li, Zhijie Lin, Jiyang Liu, Yitong Wang, Jiashi Feng, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jun Hao Liew
papers.abstract: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction, where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. This enables seamless edits across various tasks, including object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation. Notably, it can be easily implemented with feature replacement in inference. QK-Edit demonstrates superior editing performance on state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX and HunyuanVideo, effectively bridging the gap between generative power and editable flexibility in MM-DiTs, and paving the way for scalable multimodal content creation.
papers.summary_cn: 针对多模态扩散Transformer中多模态自注意力机制使传统U-Net注意力操控编辑方法失效的问题，提出免训练框架QK-Edit，通过新颖的查询-键操控策略隔离并调整关键注意力组件，在提示保真度与结构一致性间取得最优平衡，且仅需推理时特征替换即可实现。该方法支持物体增删替换、背景、材质、颜色修改及风格迁移等多种图像与视频编辑任务，性能优于现有最先进方法。

papers.title: OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Mengke Zhang, Tianyi Yang, Xinzhuo Li, Anlong Ming
papers.abstract: Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry from appearance under severe visual shifts, easily triggering structural hallucinations. Therefore, our core insight is to model open-world depth estimation as consistent geometric inference across multi-style images, fully leveraging the powerful structure-preserving editing priors of Image-to-Image (I2I) models. Based on this, we propose OpenDepth, a robust open-world MDE framework that introduces "Intra-Domain Awareness" -- the capability to map diverse stylistic inputs sharing identical geometry into a unified latent space. To achieve this, we first align shallow features within the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to anchor degraded observations to unified geometric representations. Additionally, we introduce a joint RGB latent reconstruction task, requiring the model to recover clean RGB information from degraded inputs. This multi-stage strategy effectively decouples environmental style interference, compelling the model to focus strictly on underlying geometric recovery. Extensive evaluations show that OpenDepth sets new SOTA records for robust zero-shot depth estimation across standard and extreme weather benchmarks, demonstrating exceptional structural integrity and adaptability.
papers.summary_cn: 现有基于文生图生成先验的单目深度估计方法在光照变化、恶劣天气等开放世界扰动下性能骤降，因先验侧重语义合成而非像素级结构保持，易产生结构幻觉。为此提出OpenDepth，将开放世界深度估计建模为跨多风格图像的一致几何推理，利用图生图模型的结构保持编辑先验，引入域内感知能力，将共享相同几何的不同风格输入映射到统一潜空间，并对齐扩散Transformer的浅层特征以锚定退化观测，从而提升开放世界场景下深度估计的鲁棒性。

papers.title: FlashVSR+: Efficient Video Super-Resolution via Hybrid Attention and Reward-Yield Distribution Matching
papers.authors: Ruchang Yao, Shi Guo, Junhao Zhuang, Mingde Yao, Xin Cai, Jiahao Zhan, Bin Fu, Xinyuan Chen, Yu Qiao, Tianfan Xue
papers.abstract: Recent video super-resolution (VSR) models achieve efficient one-step generation through diffusion distillation. However, high-resolution inference remains costly, and distilled models are difficult to align with human preferences. These challenges call for improvements in both model architecture and training strategy. We present \textbf{FlashVSR+} to address both limitations. On the architecture side, we introduce hybrid attention based on the strong locality observed in pretrained VSR models, while retaining sparse global interaction for long-range consistency. It achieves up to $2\times$ DiT speedup and 45\% lower peak memory, enabling spatially untiled 4K VSR on a single 24GB RTX 4090. On the training side, we propose Reward-Yield Distribution Matching Distillation (Ry-DMD) for preference-aligned one-step generation. Ry-DMD uses reward-weighted teacher rollouts to incorporate black-box rewards into distribution matching, without backpropagating through the reward model. We further show that Ry-DMD generalizes beyond VSR to T2I generation. Together, FlashVSR+ delivers stronger restoration quality and substantially improves high-resolution efficiency, with consistent gains in user preference. We release our code, models, and training data at \href{https://www.flashvsr.tech}{\textcolor{FlashBlue}{\textbf{www.flashvsr.tech}}}.
papers.summary_cn: 针对扩散蒸馏视频超分辨率模型高分辨率推理成本高、难以对齐人类偏好的问题，FlashVSR+从架构与训练两方面改进：架构上利用预训练模型的强局部性设计混合注意力，保留稀疏全局交互，实现最高2倍DiT加速、峰值显存降低45%，可在单张24GB显存的RTX 4090上完成无分块4K超分；训练上提出奖励加权分布匹配蒸馏，无需对奖励模型反向传播即可融入黑盒奖励，并可推广至文生图任务，兼顾修复质量与效率提升。

papers.title: HairFlow: Modeling 3D Hair Strands with Multi-Modal Conditioned Diffusion
papers.authors: Yating Wang, Kui Wu, Ran Yi, Zixuan Lu, Tongtong Wang, Zhongtian Zheng, Lizhuang Ma, Yuefan Shen
papers.abstract: Modeling 3D hair strands is challenging due to complex hairstyle geometry, scarce high-quality training data, and incomplete or noisy input observations. Foundation models offer broader hairstyle priors, but their outputs are not directly usable for strand-based rendering and simulation. Existing approaches require costly per-instance optimization to fit hair priors to meshes from foundation models and 2D orientations from specialized predictors trained on limited hair data, restricting efficiency and generalization. We present HairFlow, a multimodal conditioned diffusion framework for efficient and controllable hair strands modeling. HairFlow conditions strand generation on two complementary representations: a coarse mesh that constrains global shape and multi-view sketches that specify local strand flow. HairFlow combines an Orientation VAE with a conditioned diffusion transformer to generate volumetric fields that are traced into explicit strands. To overcome the lack of paired sketch-strand training data, we introduce an automatic synthesis pipeline that generates geometrically aligned multi-view sketches with diverse styles representative of inference-time inputs. Experiments show that HairFlow generates plausible 3D strands that faithfully follow the input conditions across diverse hairstyles, substantially reduces inference time, and supports flexible multimodal control.
papers.summary_cn: 面向三维发丝建模中几何复杂、数据稀缺、观测不全且基础模型输出难以直接用于渲染仿真的问题，HairFlow 以粗网格约束整体形状、多视角草图指定局部流向，结合方向变分自编码器与条件扩散变换器生成体素场并追踪成显式发丝；自动合成几何对齐草图缓解配对数据不足，在效率、可控性与泛化上优于逐实例优化流程。

papers.title: AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Javad Rajabi, Koorosh Roohi, David B. Lindell, Babak Taati
papers.abstract: Generating images beyond the training resolution of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remains challenging, as the number of tokens grows rapidly with resolution, full attention becomes expensive, and outputs often suffer from structural distortions and degraded detail. We identify uniform full attention as the common source of both problems. Attending to all tokens at every step causes quadratic cost and exposes the model to more tokens and relative distances beyond the training range, pushing the model out of distribution. We observe that attention's effective receptive field narrows during denoising, from global in early steps that form structure to local in later steps that refine details. We propose AReA, a training-free attention mechanism whose receptive field evolves from coarse to fine, following the denoising progression. In early steps, AReA applies cross-scale coarse attention over downsampled keys and values, capturing global context, while in later steps it applies local attention within progressively shrinking windows. Without additional parameters or training, experiments show that AReA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free baselines across target resolutions and different models, while also being faster and more efficient.
papers.summary_cn: 针对扩散变换器超出训练分辨率生成时标记激增、全注意力代价过高及结构畸变的问题，发现去噪过程中有效感受野会由全局逐渐收窄，据此提出无需训练和新增参数的自适应感受野注意力：早期对下采样键值执行跨尺度粗注意力，后期在逐步缩小的窗口内执行局部注意力。实验显示其在多个目标分辨率上稳定优于现有免训练方法，同时降低成本并改善结构与细节。

papers.title: DiTSG: Context-Aware Air Traffic Scene Generation with Multi-Agent Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Seokbin Yoon, Kyungmin Kim, Taejung Kwon, Keumjin Lee, Peng Wei
papers.abstract: Understanding how many aircraft, and which traffic configurations, can be safely and efficiently managed by air traffic controllers within a given airspace is fundamental to air traffic management. Air traffic controllers continuously modify aircraft trajectories through interventions such as speed advisories and radar vectoring, and the patterns of these interventions are difficult to capture effectively using existing air traffic simulators. To address this limitation, we propose Diffusion Transformers for Traffic Scene Generation (DiTSG), which learns to generate air traffic scenes from recorded multi-aircraft trajectories. DiTSG employs stacked multi-agent inverted Transformer layers as the denoising backbone of a diffusion transformer, jointly generates the trajectories of multiple aircraft within a traffic scene, and conditions the generation on agent-specific required times of arrival. The resulting trajectories generated by DiTSG preserve realistic inter-aircraft interactions observed in actual air traffic operations. Experiments show that the DiTSG generates diverse traffic scenes that reproduce the statistical properties of recorded traffic while preserving realistic inter-aircraft interactions.
papers.summary_cn: 针对现有空中交通模拟器难以刻画管制员速度建议与雷达引导等干预模式的问题，提出基于扩散变换器的多机交通场景生成方法DiTSG。其核心是以堆叠的多智能体倒置Transformer层作为扩散模型的去噪骨干，联合生成同一场景内多架航空器的轨迹，并以各机特定的要求到达时间为条件进行引导。实验表明，生成场景具有多样性，能复现真实交通记录的统计特性，并保留实际运行中的机间交互行为，有助于评估空域可安全高效容纳的航空器数量与交通构型。

papers.title: Image Tokenizers Should Be Trained Between Images
papers.authors: Ole Beißwenger, Jan-Niklas Dihlmann, Hendrik Lensch
papers.abstract: Latent diffusion models generate images as codes of an image tokenizer, whose decoder turns them into the pixel image. Recent tokenizers improve how well these codes reconstruct an image and how easily a generator learns them. Yet a generator does not reproduce the codes of training images, and when a generated code lands outside what the decoder expects, the decoded image contains imperfections. Current methods make the decoder more robust to generated codes by adding noise during training. However, generated codes lie between the training codes and resemble their mixture more than one of them plus noise. To improve generated images, decoders should therefore be trained on codes in the space between training samples. We propose InterpTok, which fine-tunes MAETok to decode mixtures of image codes into natural images. Since no target image exists between two training samples, a discriminator judges whether each decoded mixture looks as natural as its two sources. A mixing ratio loss requires the decoded mixture to keep the mixing ratio of the two codes. Together, they prevent collapse to a trivial solution and yield a sharp and natural composition of both images. InterpTok keeps MAETok's reconstruction quality and improves interpolation quality more than threefold, the best of all tokenizers in a recent benchmark. Beyond interpolation, InterpTok improves the generation FID of a matched diffusion transformer from 11.61 to 8.48 without guidance, and even reaches 8.11 at an eighth of the sampling steps, where the generator on MAETok's codes worsens. The generator trained on our tokenizer also reaches the final result of the one trained on MAETok at half the training steps. Our findings show that the space between image codes can and should be explicitly supervised rather than ignored.
papers.summary_cn: 潜在扩散模型生成的图像编码常落在解码器训练分布之外，导致解码图像出现瑕疵；现有方法通过加噪增强解码器鲁棒性，但生成编码实际位于训练编码之间，更接近两者的混合。为此提出InterpTok，对MAETok解码器微调，使其能将两个图像编码的混合解码为自然图像。由于混合编码无真实目标图像，引入判别器判断解码结果是否自然，并设计混合比例损失约束解码结果保持两编码的混合比例，避免退化解，最终生成锐利自然的组合图像，同时保持MAETok原有重建能力。

papers.title: The Midas Touch for Metric Depth: Interpretable Metricization for Generalizable Depth Perception
papers.authors: Mengtan Zhang, Yu Ma, Shiqi Jiang, Yi Feng, Wei Ye, Xieyuanli Chen, Hanli Wang, Qijun Chen, Rui Fan
papers.abstract: Recent foundation models have drastically improved the generalization of monocular relative depth estimation, yet recovering accurate metric depth from their estimates for depth perception tasks remains challenging due to scale ambiguity and local metric-scale inconsistency. Existing approaches recover metric depth from sparse observations using either explicit global affine transformation algorithms or implicit data-driven depth completion networks. The former cannot accommodate spatially varying relative-to-metric relationships, while the latter are sensitive to the distribution of sparse observations and may not fully exploit generalizable relative depth priors. To simultaneously address these issues, this study extends our previous work MTD and proposes MTDv2, a hybrid metric depth perception framework that combines explicit depth metricization with data-driven metric depth refinement. The explicit depth metricization process performs segment-wise affine transformations to recover spatially varying metric scales while preserving the geometric structure of relative depth, followed by pixel-wise depth refinement that propagates metric observations along paths with minimal accumulated geometric variation. The data-driven depth refinement process subsequently extends the explicit single-path depth propagation to a learnable multi-path formulation while preserving its interpretability. Extensive experiments conducted on 16 public datasets demonstrate the robust and generalizable depth scale recovery capability of MTDv2 across diverse sources of sparse observations and different depth estimation paradigms, as well as its broad applicability to downstream 3D perception tasks. Code will be publicly available at https://mias.group/MTD upon publication.
papers.summary_cn: 针对基础模型相对深度估计的尺度模糊与局部尺度不一致，MTDv2 以混合框架恢复单目度量深度：先做分段仿射度量化，刻画空间变化的相对到度量映射并保持几何结构，再沿最小累积误差路径传播稀疏观测完成像素级细化，从而兼顾显式变换的可解释性与数据驱动精化，在泛化场景中提升度量深度精度与鲁棒性。

papers.title: JtT: Rethinking Point Trajectory Diffusion for Diverse and Rigid Motion from an Image
papers.authors: Gabrijel Boduljak, Yushi Lan, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi
papers.abstract: We study forecasting rigid-body motion from a single image: generating diverse and physically plausible future trajectories for arbitrary points in a scene, without building rigidity into the architecture or relying on geometric inputs such as depth. Like video generators, recent trajectory generators fail at this task, even in simple synthetic Kubric scenes, despite scaling up model size and training on real data.   We show how to solve this with the right architecture and parameterization. Our model, JtT, is a simple diffusion transformer that operates directly in coordinate space and decodes arbitrary and dense query patterns, without the trajectory VAEs or fixed grids assumed in prior work. Through a systematic study of the design space of point trajectory diffusion, we find that diffusing per-frame velocities is the only parameterization that captures rigidity, that it must be paired with the right timestep schedule, and that adding full-resolution RGB at the query points resolves the boundary failures of prior methods.   However, evaluating such 2D models rigorously is itself non-trivial. To our knowledge, we are the first to observe that physical plausibility and diversity do not improve together during training: larger models, as used in prior work, memorize the single ground-truth future per training image, becoming more rigid while covering fewer possible futures.   Yet prior work has paid little attention to this, so we show how model rankings depend on model size, metric, and stopping time, and adopt a stricter, checkpoint-averaged evaluation protocol. Under this protocol, JtT improves over prior methods on both distributional and rigidity metrics and approaches ground-truth rigidity, with only about 50M parameters.
papers.summary_cn: 从单张图像预测任意场景点的未来轨迹，难点是同时保证多样性、物理可信与刚体一致，且不依赖深度或把刚性写进结构。JtT 用坐标空间扩散变换器直接解码任意密集查询，系统比较发现逐帧速度扩散是唯一能保持刚性的参数化，需配合合适时间步调度，并以查询点全分辨率彩色信息修正边界失效；在合成 Kubric 场景中，既有方法放大模型与真实数据仍失败。

papers.title: Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration
papers.authors: Lei Zhu, Mujie Lin, Ruochong Zheng, Guangyi Wang, Hao Li, Peng Jin, Chang Liu, Jie Chen
papers.abstract: Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density. To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.
papers.summary_cn: 针对扩散模型推理时反复去噪开销大的问题，提出免训练的加速框架 BeziCast。该方法用低阶贝塞尔轨迹预测靠近输出的去噪特征表示，通过 Tikhonov 正则化拟合控制点，避免高阶导数估计带来的不稳定，并引入凸包护栏约束外推幅度。相比基于泰勒有限差分的缓存预测方法，该方案在长缓存间隔下更稳定，减少误差在去噪模块间的累积，在保持生成质量的同时显著降低推理计算量，且无需重训练生成器或修改采样器。

papers.title: World Models Need a Physical Registry: Learning Internal Predictive States for Physically Plausible World Models
papers.authors: Shinseong Kim, Jaeseok Jeong, Jianlong Fu, Youngjung Uh
papers.abstract: Video world models must generate physically plausible futures, not just realistic frames. Existing approaches typically use semantic, physical, or predictive information to guide the visual generation stream, leaving a fundamental question: where inside the generator should predictions of scene evolution live? Standard video tokens jointly encode appearance and dynamics, but provide no distinct state for learning and reading predictive dynamics. We answer this question with the Physical Registry: temporally grounded registry slots inside a video DiT that are initialized from an observation-conditioned forecast, co-evolve with video tokens, and receive future-representation supervision, making predictive dynamics an explicit, readable state of the generator. In a controlled comparison of predictive-state interfaces on Physics-IQ Verified, Physical Registry improves vanilla fine-tuning by 9.9/8.7 points on I2V/V2V, the largest gain among the interfaces we compare. Across all Cosmos and WAN backbones, Physical Registry improves Physics-IQ Verified scores. With only 0.45% additional parameters, it enables Cosmos 3 Nano 16B to surpass the published I2V score of Cosmos 3 Super 64B (43.56 vs. 42.7). On WorldModelBench, it also improves physical adherence and the total score for all four evaluated backbones. Because the registry becomes candidate-specific while remaining readable, the Physical Registry Selector (PRS) ranks emerging futures by how far their intermediate registry readouts depart from the shared forecast before full denoising is complete. Across four backbones, this selection improves I2V scores by 5.6-15.9% without completed-video external scoring. Together, these results support a broader principle: dynamics prediction should live as an explicit model state that co-evolves with the video representation. Project page: https://grainsack.github.io/physical-registry/
papers.summary_cn: 视频世界模型需生成物理合理的未来而不仅是逼真画面，但现有方法缺乏专门承载场景演化预测的内部状态。为此提出Physical Registry：在视频DiT中嵌入由观测条件预测初始化的时间对齐注册槽，与视频token共同演化并接受未来表征监督，使预测动态成为显式可读的生成器状态。在Physics-IQ Verified上，较原始微调在I2V/V2V分别提升9.9/8.7分，仅增加0.45%参数便使Cosmos 3 Nano 16B超过Cosmos 3 Super 64B的43.56分。

papers.title: MFlowHOI: Whole-Body Human-Object Interaction Generation via Part-Aware MeanFlow
papers.authors: Qiang He, Yonghao Zhang, Yinda Zhang, Chenyu Meng, Liufei Ouyang, Haoxiang Hu, Cangjun Gao, Xiaoming Deng, Cuixia Ma, Hongan Wang
papers.abstract: Whole-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires coordinating body and finger motion, object trajectories, and time-varying contacts. Existing methods typically rely on iterative diffusion or test-time optimization, resulting in high inference costs. Direct one-step generation is highly desired in downstream applications due to efficient inference. However, it is challenging because these HOI components differ substantially in structure and scale. We present MFlowHOI, an efficient one-step framework for whole-body HOI generation. A Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE organizes body, hand, object, and contact signals into a structured latent space, with a shared decoder preserving their global coordination. An ST-DiT then models temporal and cross-part dependencies in this space and generates a complete interaction in a single MeanFlow evaluation. Predicted object-local contact correspondences further enable geometric refinement and interaction-preserving transfer to photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatars with different body proportions. Experiments demonstrate that MFlowHOI outperforms existing base generators in motion quality and text alignment while substantially reducing inference time.
papers.summary_cn: 面向全身人-物交互生成中身体与手指运动、物体轨迹和时变接触难以协调、且迭代扩散或测试时优化推理成本高的问题，提出用接触感知多部位残差向量量化把身体、手、物体与接触组织进共享解码的协调潜空间，再以时空变换器建模时序与跨部位依赖，经MeanFlow单次评估生成完整交互，并用物体局部接触对应做几何精修与迁移到不同体型的高斯化身；实验显示运动质量与文本对齐优于现有生成器，同时大幅降低推理开销。

papers.title: Frequency-Step Cache: Separating Synchronization and Repair for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Kerry Xu, Param Misra, Zachary Stenglein, Athri Karunamurthy, Fanjiang Ye, Yuke Wang
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video generation enables long-horizon synthesis but requires repeated forward passes through large diffusion transformers. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing intermediate computation, yet existing controllers often couple two decisions: when to synchronize the cache exactly and how much computation to repair between synchronizations. We introduce Frequency-Step Cache (FSC), which separates these roles. FSC schedules exact full-computation anchors on a dense-to-sparse trajectory, while a lightweight latent-space risk based on frequency-resolved drift and token age controls inter-anchor repair through whole-step replay, selective token recomputation, or full repair. On SkyReels-V2, whole-step reuse provides most of the acceleration, while selective token computation is most effective as fidelity repair. A controlled ablation shows that using one reactive signal for both synchronization and repair reduces fidelity at matched latency, with the same separation advantage observed on FramePack and Matrix-Game. Across multiple autoregressive video backbones, FSC improves speed-quality trade-offs. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Speed reaches 2.36x speedup versus MotionCache's 2.275x while improving SSIM by 0.019 and PSNR by 0.5 dB. At MotionCache-matched speed, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.031 and PSNR by 1.0 dB and lowers LPIPS by 0.024. Without retuning, FSC-Quality transfers to SkyReels-V2 14B at 2.12x speedup versus 1.79x for MotionCache.
papers.summary_cn: 自回归视频生成需反复前向计算，成本高昂。Frequency-Step Cache（FSC）将缓存同步与修复两个决策解耦：沿由密到疏的轨迹安排精确全量计算锚点，再以基于频率漂移与词元年龄的轻量潜空间风险信号控制锚点间的修复（整步重放、选择性词元重算或全量修复）。在SkyReels-V2、FramePack、Matrix-Game等骨干上，FSC改善了速度与质量的权衡，FSC-Speed相对基线达到2.36倍加速，消融验证了分离设计在同延迟下保真度更优。

papers.title: MultiFlow: Vision-Driven Multimodal fMRI Encoding via Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching
papers.authors: Bui Van Hung, Hoang-Son Vo, Mai Duc Minh Huy, Dang Thanh Vu, Soo-Hyung Kim
papers.abstract: Current fMRI encoding models frame prediction as deterministic regression, yet identical stimuli evoke a distribution of neural responses (arising from physiological noise, hemodynamic variability, and cognitive fluctuations) that a single point estimate cannot capture. This work introduces MultiFlow, a generative fMRI encoding framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) and a formulation termed Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching (SISFM). SISFM generalises CFM by conditioning the source distribution on the stimulus: a learnable temporal convolution shapes the source mean with an HRF-length receptive field, while a variance head shrinks its scale, shortening the expected transport path. SISFM is instantiated with a Diffusion Transformer (DiT-X) decoder parameterising the velocity field, with sub-layer Attention Residuals, heterogeneous fusion of ten frozen vision, audio, language, and audiovisual backbones, and per-subject Yeo-network heads. On the Algonauts 2025 dataset, a single MultiFlow checkpoint recovers most of the benefit of large deterministic ensembles: it trails the 1000-model TRIBE ensemble in-distribution by 0.003 PCC (0.3163 vs. 0.3195), and the strongest in- and out-of-distribution ensembles (VIBE-20, MedARC-50) by 0.010 and 0.009 PCC, using a single trained model rather than an ensemble of 20-1000. The same checkpoint also provides stimulus-conditioned uncertainty estimates and sample-based diversity.
papers.summary_cn: 针对相同刺激诱发分布式fMRI响应、确定回归只能给点估计的问题，提出生成式编码框架MultiFlow：用刺激条件化源分布的流匹配缩短传输路径，结合DiT-X速度场、注意力残差、十种冻结多模态骨干融合与被试特异Yeo头。Algonauts 2025上单模型达0.3163 PCC，仅落后1000模型TRIBE集成0.003，逼近大集成收益。

papers.title: ASM-6D: Fast Certified Pose-Shape Inference with Complete Correspondence Flow Maps
papers.authors: Ho Jin Choi, Minku Kim, Nadia Figueroa
papers.abstract: Category-level 6D pose and shape estimation requires recovering an object's pose and geometry from partial observations without an exact instance model. We present ASM-6D, which couples generative complete-geometry prediction with explicit category-level pose-shape inference through shared correspondences. Given an RGB-D image, ASM-6D generates alternative complete 3D correspondence hypotheses whose point identities are shared with a category-level Active Shape Model (ASM), including occluded points. Each hypothesis is fitted directly for rotation, translation, metric scale, and instance shape without a separate correspondence-assignment stage. We analytically eliminate translation and shape coefficients, reducing fitting to a nine-variable scaled-rotation optimization problem that enables efficient batched evaluation of multiple hypotheses in real time. ASM-6D achieves state-of-the-art performance on ROPE and HouseCat6D benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate the importance of generative correspondence prediction and active shape variation. The representation also supports shape completion, shape-dependent pose ambiguity, tracking, and robotic grasping at 6-38 Hz, depending on the inference budget.
papers.summary_cn: 面向类别级6D位姿与形状估计中仅有部分观测、无精确实例模型的问题，ASM-6D用生成式完整几何预测产生与类别主动形状模型共享点身份且含遮挡点的对应假设，并解析消去平移与形状系数，把拟合化为九变量缩放旋转优化，支持批量实时评估。在ROPE和HouseCat6D达最优，消融验证两项设计关键，还可支持补全、跟踪与6-38Hz抓取。

papers.title: Learning Dynamic Grasping
papers.authors: Nga Kiu Kelly Ho, Yilin Liu, Hao Xu, Niloy J. Mitra
papers.abstract: Synthesizing believable 4D hand-object grasping sequences is important for character animation, extended reality, and embodied agents. Grasping requires a hand to approach, contact, and lift or manipulate an object coherently. Existing synthesis methods often model only the final static grasp or rely on additional conditions, such as language, target grasps, or object trajectories, to specify the interaction. We instead study the underconstrained problem of generating a complete grasping motion from a single initial hand-object state. Our framework decouples hand-motion generation from object-motion recovery. Given an object point cloud in the initial wrist frame and the initial parameterized hand configuration, conditional flow matching predicts a sequence-level contact map and a hand pose at each normalized sequence time. This time-indexed formulation avoids the error accumulation of autoregressive rollout while representing the complete motion. We then infer an attachment frame and recover rigid-object motion through training-free, contact-guided weighted registration. We evaluate on held-out DexYCB objects and unseen object geometries reconstructed from in-the-wild videos by Open-CHOIR. Compared with LatentHOI, our method produces smoother hand and object motion in every setting, matches or improves on its contact and penetration metrics in the wild under a shared initialization, and is about 30x faster per generated frame. In a 15-participant study, our motions were preferred in roughly two thirds of (forced-choice pairwise) comparisons. Precise contact closure on novel geometry, however, remains a key open challenge.
papers.summary_cn: 针对仅由初始手-物状态生成完整抓取动作的欠约束问题，将手部运动合成与物体运动恢复解耦：以初始手腕坐标系下的物体点云和参数化手型为条件，用条件流匹配按归一化序列时刻预测序列级接触图与手姿，避免自回归误差累积；再推断附着坐标系，经免训练的接触引导加权配准恢复刚体物体运动。在DexYCB留出物体及野外视频重建的未见几何上验证，能生成接近、接触并抓起或操作的连贯4D手物序列。

papers.title: AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation
papers.authors: Nan Wu, Yee Hung Hong
papers.abstract: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. An expanded 24-prompt evaluation (216 videos) yields 9.7% lower aggregate CoTracker3 cycle error than the matched control and near-matched performance on six VBench dimensions; however, the seed-level tracking effect is heterogeneous and I3D-FVD regresses from 0.1824 to 0.2022. These results support a bounded claim: conflict-aware adaptation improves correspondence consistency without broad perceptual degradation, but does not uniformly improve video quality. We release equations, pseudocode, matched outputs, source tables, and artifact provenance.
papers.summary_cn: 针对视频生成模型微调中显式点对应监督可能破坏预训练外观先验的矛盾，在50.1亿参数文本到视频扩散Transformer上提出AcrossVAM2.0，结合置信度加权的轨迹与可见性头、零初始化残差反馈和非对称PCGrad，仅移除与主流匹配梯度冲突的辅助分量，从而在初始化时完整保留生成器。消融实验显示KLT循环误差在三个种子上均下降（均值-0.00711），扩展评测中CoTracker3循环误差降低9.7%，VBench六维表现接近基线，但I3D-FVD有所退化。

papers.title: Demiurge: Forging Navigable 4D Worlds via Autoregressive Video Rerendering
papers.authors: Hanxin Zhu, Jianqi Ma, Cong Wang, Zhihao Hu, Junyao Gao, Tianyu He, Junyan Lin, Jiayin Xiao, Jiateng Shou, Sen Liang, Weidong Zhang, Zhibo Chen, Jun Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/.
papers.summary_cn: 现有单视频新视角合成方法独立处理相机轨迹，缺乏跨轨迹一致性，难以构建连贯可导航的4D世界。为此提出Demiurge，一种基于动态4D点云记忆缓存的自回归视频重渲染流水线，包含外观视频扩散、记忆一致性深度补全、记忆感知双流warping与几何感知视频精化四个组件，以保持跨轨迹一致性并消除尺度歧义。实验表明该方法达到最先进性能，能在密集多视角轨迹上构建连贯时空格点。

papers.title: Competition Domains Matter: Selective Head Globalization for Training-Free Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Tiantian Liu, Meng Wan, Zhiqiang Liang, Jue Wang, Ningming Nie, Yangang Wang
papers.abstract: Training-free sparse attention is a practical route to efficient video diffusion transformer inference, yet existing methods typically fix the competition domain at each query row for every attention head. Prior work primarily addresses how to estimate token-level importance within this fixed domain; whether the domain itself should adapt to head heterogeneity remains under-specified. We introduce EG-Sparse, a training-free framework that routes low-entropy heads to a grouped cross-head pool while retaining per-row local selection for high-entropy heads, using only scores already materialized by the sparse pipeline. A controlled diagnostic fixes the ranking score and varies only the competition rule: grouped cross-head selection reduces low-entropy-head reconstruction error by 9.8%, whereas forcing high-entropy heads into an all-head global pool increases it by 7.9%. Across four configurations, EG-Sparse achieves higher video quality while reducing attention density and GPU denoising latency compared with strong training-free sparse-attention baselines. Mechanism ablations further show that selective domain adaptation outperforms uniform, random, and fixed domain-assignment policies. These results support competition-domain adaptation as a distinct design axis within centroid-guided training-free sparse attention.
papers.summary_cn: 面向视频扩散Transformer高效推理，免训练稀疏注意力常把每个查询行的竞争域固定到所有头，忽视头间差异。EG-Sparse按熵分流：低熵头进入分组跨头池，高熵头保留逐行局部选择，仅复用稀疏管线已得分数。受控实验显示分组跨头使低熵头重建误差降9.8%，强令高熵头用全头全局池反升7.9%；四组配置质量更高且注意力密度与GPU去噪延迟更低。

papers.title: We Have Been Interpreting Diffusion Transformer Backbone Behaviors Wrong
papers.authors: Benyuan Meng, Longtao Huang, Yang Liu, Liang Lin
papers.abstract: During a network forward call, diffusion backbones naturally produce many intermediate activations. If we evaluate each activation against an identical downstream benchmarking protocol, we can plot an inverted-U-shaped curve as the depth profile: the activation's performance goes up first and then down as we go into deeper layers. This is common knowledge in the diffusion model community, which inspires many applications including the widely-adopted REPA. However, the common interpretation of this depth profile may be inaccurate and incomplete: (i) The cause of this curve has long been treated as signal granularity changing from coarse to fine, but there has been little evidence in DiT backbones. (ii) The community has been mainly studying this phenomenon in a static way, without investigating how it changes across different training setups. In this work, we show a different mechanism picture for the profile, where the prediction target (e.g., $ε$, $u$, $x_0$) sits at the center. The semantically meaningful signal is only an intermediate by-product for predicting the target, while the prediction target is the real goal for the backbone. Furthermore, the choice of prediction targets as part of the training setup can predictably affect the curve's shape. With this updated interpretation, many applications of this depth profile can be better grounded and predicted. As an example, we show how to predict the near-optimal placement of REPA based on the prediction target of the training setup. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-compare.
papers.summary_cn: 重新审视扩散Transformer中间激活随深度呈倒U的常用解释，指出“粒度由粗到细”缺乏DiT证据且多为静态观察。核心思路是把预测目标置于中心：语义信号只是预测ε、u或x0时的中间副产物，目标才是骨干网络真正优化对象，并追踪不同训练设置下剖面变化。所给片段未列具体数值，结论强调目标选择会支配深度曲线，动摇REPA等应用的解释基础。

papers.title: Images Talk Back: Guiding MMDiTs by Suppressing Image-to-Text Feedback
papers.authors: Yucheng Yang, Xiaoxiao Sun, Shusheng Yang, Jiakang Chen, Serena Yeung-Levy
papers.abstract: Multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs) allow the evolving image to update internal text representations through joint attention. These representations then guide subsequent image updates, raising a question: does this feedback help correct deviations from the prompt, or preserve them? We find that image-to-text (I2T) feedback can preserve the objects and attributes already represented in the evolving image, including errors. Transplanting I2T messages can rescue failures or disrupt successes. At matched intervention strengths, suppressing the influence of I2T feedback improves generation, whereas opposite controls degrade it. These findings motivate Semantic Feedback Guidance (SFG), which suppresses the influence of I2T feedback by guiding away from an auxiliary branch that strengthens this feedback and weakens text-to-image conditioning. The in-place variant, iSFG, directly suppresses I2T feedback and strengthens text-to-image conditioning, requiring no extra model evaluations. Temporal interventions motivate running the SFG branch during the first 20% of image sampling steps, requiring about $1.2\times$ the base NFE without classifier-free guidance (CFG). Experiments across three image-generation backbones show gains in alignment and preference-model scores. On FLUX, adding SFG to CFG raises GenEval from $0.6661$ to $0.7479$; on SD3.5M, iSFG adds $+1.33$ HPSv2.1 over CFG at zero extra NFE. The control also transfers to text-to-video and image-to-video generation, improving VBench scores. Code is available at https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/SFG.
papers.summary_cn: 多模态扩散Transformer中图像会通过联合注意力反向更新文本表征，研究发现这种图像到文本（I2T）反馈会保留图像中已有的物体和属性，包括错误，从而固化偏差而非纠正。为此提出语义反馈引导（SFG），借助一个强化I2T反馈、弱化文本条件的辅助分支进行反向引导以抑制该反馈；其原地变体iSFG无需额外模型评估。仅在前20%采样步启用SFG分支，开销约为基准NFE的1.2倍（不含CFG），即可在多组实验中稳定提升生成质量。

papers.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
papers.authors: Changhao Wang, Jaden Clark, Shuran Song
papers.abstract: Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We study two ways to incorporate time into a diffusion transformer: adding timestamp embeddings to token features, or encoding physical time in positional encoding through time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE). We find that time-aware RoPE is more robust, allowing attention to depend directly on physical time while keeping token content unchanged. During training, we temporally randomize which observations are sampled and when the action chunk begins, exposing the policy to a wider range of sensing and execution schedules that may occur during deployments. This also enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data without forcing all measurements onto a fixed temporal grid. Across simulation and real-world experiments, Chronos Policy improves performance on dynamic tasks, where observation-to-action timing is critical, and on multisensory tasks, where the relative timing between observations matters. On standard quasi-static tasks, it preserves nominal performance while improving robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.
papers.summary_cn: 针对机器人策略将传感与控制固化为等间隔序列、把时间隐含于序列位置，导致在观测频率、延迟或推理耗时变化时失效的问题，提出Chronos Policy，将物理时间显式化，通过观测采集时刻与动作执行时刻进行条件化。方法比较了两种时间注入方式：将时间戳嵌入加入token特征，或通过时间感知旋转位置编码（time-aware RoPE）编码物理时间，发现后者更鲁棒，使注意力直接依赖物理时间且不改变token内容。训练时对观测采样与动作块起始时刻做时间随机化，使策略适应多样的传感与执行调度，并可从异步多速率数据中学习。仿真与真机实验表明该方法在动态任务上性能提升。

papers.title: SmolWAM: A Latent World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation on Edge Devices
papers.authors: Timi Owolabi, Hikmah Olawore, Frances Adelakun, Ayotomiwa Oyewumi
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) predict a robot's actions together with the observations those actions will produce. However, the strongest models rely on video diffusion transformers that are far too computationally expensive for resource-constrained edge devices. We present SmolWAM, a latent WAM that we derive from the 2B-parameter Cosmos Policy by keeping its pretrained trunk and rebuilding its inference interface: single-frame visual latents, cached text features that preserve the trunk's attention sinks, 12 of 28 transformer blocks, and 1,008 tokens from which actions and future visual latents are read out in one rectified-flow step. Trained in 3.6 GPU-hours, SmolWAM succeeds in 95.5% of 400 LIBERO episodes at 57 ms and 2.3 TFLOP per 16-action chunk with 2.4 GiB of GPU memory, 11x faster than its teacher with 18.5x fewer FLOPs and 3.2x less memory, and its world head still forecasts scene motion.
papers.summary_cn: 边缘设备算力有限，难以部署依赖视频扩散 Transformer 的世界-动作模型。SmolWAM 从 20 亿参数的 Cosmos Policy 出发，保留预训练主干，仅保留 28 个块中的 12 个，采用单帧视觉潜变量与缓存文本特征，用 1008 个 token 经一步 rectified-flow 同时读出动作与未来视觉潜变量。训练仅 3.6 GPU 小时，在 400 个 LIBERO 任务上成功率 95.5%，每 16 步动作块耗时 57 毫秒、2.3 TFLOP、显存 2.4 GiB，较教师模型快 11 倍、算力省 18.5 倍、显存省 3.2 倍。
